Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência com sistema SAP e Power BI.

Responsabilidades e atividades do cargo

  • Suporte à gerência na organização e condução das reuniões semanais de coordenação e reuniões mensais de performance da área.
  • Ponto focal da área para todas as atividades administrativa e backoffice.
  • Suporte para as analistas de projeto com os processos de gestão de contratos, aprovações internas, orçamento, indicadores, metas, entre outras atividades de backoffice.

Um pouco do que a Vale oferece para você

  • Previdência Privada: garantia de um futuro tranquilo, com segurança financeira para a aposentadoria.
  • PLR - Programa de Participação nos Lucros e Resultados: reconhecimento pelos esforços de todos, com participação nos lucros da empresa
  • Assistência Médica e Hospitalar, Odontológica: Cuidados de saúde completos para empregados e seus dependentes, prezando por aquilo que é prioritário em garantia: Saúde e qualidade de vida;
  • Reembolso Creche ou Auxílio Babá: apoio para conciliar o retorno ao trabalho com a chegada de um filho - até os 6 anos dos dependentes;
  • PASA - Planos de saúde para familiares ou para o próprio empregado, em caso de aposentadoria ou desligamento;
  • Vale alimentação: suporte financeiro para compras de itens de mercado;
  • Vale refeição ou Refeições no trabalho: benefício para facilitar a rotina e promover hábitos saudáveis na alimentação diária;
  • Apoiar - Programa Assistência ao Empregado e Dependentes: suporte emocional e social especializados para empregados e suas famílias;
  • Cartão Presente de Natal para Dependentes: um gesto de carinho no final do ano - para dependentes até 10 anos;
  • Transporte fretado ou Vale transporte: garantias de deslocamento diário de nossos empregados para o ambiente de trabalho;
  • Passagens de trem de passageiros na Estrada de Ferro Vitória a Minas (EFVM) e/ou na Estrada de Ferro Carajás (EFC). Destinadas para uso pessoal, viabilizando mais uma opção logística para viagens dos empregados;
  • Incentivo à atividade física - Wellhub: promoção de saúde física e bem-estar com programas de atividade física;
  • Programa Bem-Estar: cuidados integrais para melhorar a qualidade de vida dos empregados;
  • Clube de Vantagens: Descontos e benefícios exclusivos para compras em estabelecimentos parceiros.

Entre outros ...

Nossa transformação cultural

A Vale é uma mineradora que busca acelerar a transição para um mundo mais sustentável, que coloca a segurança no centro de tudo o que faz e trabalha para construir soluções para os desafios da humanidade - transformando, hoje, o futuro. Aprendemos juntos, e seguimos comprometidos com a nossa transformação cultural para gerar, com as pessoas, valor e impacto positivo por meio das nossas atividades. Avançando a cada dia, nos sentimos prontos para cultivar relações sólidas e estabelecer sempre o diálogo aberto com a sociedade.

Por que vagas preferenciais para mulheres?

A Vale está em uma jornada de transformação, na busca de se tornar uma empresa mais diversa, equitativa e inclusiva. Além disso, acreditamos que o avanço em equidade de gênero contribui para a construção de um futuro melhor para todos. Queremos aumentar a representatividade de todas as mulheres: pretas, brancas, com qualquer identidade de gênero e orientação sexual ou que tenham algum tipo de deficiência.

Como é trabalhar na Vale?

Na Vale, contribuímos para a formação de futuros. Da mineração, do planeta e o seu. Oferecemos oportunidades para diversas áreas e objetivos profissionais. Aqui, nossos talentos constroem juntos um ambiente colaborativo e inclusivo que valoriza a pessoa como ela é: sua individualidade, seu protagonismo e comprometimento.

A Vale não realiza nenhum tipo de cobrança para participação em nenhuma etapa dos seus processos seletivos. Todas as candidaturas devem ser feitas exclusivamente pelo nosso site ou por meio de vagas postadas no perfil da Vale no LinkedIn.

title: Learning Content Designer, SSD
description:
The goal of Amazon Logistics is to build a world class operation. Amazon aims to exceed the expectations of our customers by ensuring that their orders are delivered quickly, accurately, and in the most cost-effective way possible. We are looking for creative leaders with a passion for highly complex challenges, a knack for problem solving, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Amazon Logistics is looking for a Learning Content Designer. This position will support UTR programs by designing learning solutions to ensure quality of processes, drive standards adoption and offer a great learning experience.

As Learning Content Designer, you will be responsible for content creation that will support UTR Operations in multiple learning approaches, such as e-learning, video and instructor‑led training. You will also interact with business areas in order to identify learning needs and content creation opportunities.

Candidate must be flexible to work weekends and/or overnight, as needed.

Key job responsibilities

  • Design and develop learning solutions in multiple approaches to UTR stakeholders
  • Use Learning Management System (LMS) to implement learning modules and measure learning KPIs
  • Apply Learning Design System (LDS) platforms that help create effective learning experiences
  • Apply instructional design principles, learning theories, and technology tools
  • Support instructor‑lead training with training content
  • Design learning communication pieces (reports, invites and announcements)

A day in the life

Throughout the day, you will collaborate closely with the Learning & Development team to ensure seamless integration of your content into our learning management system. You'll monitor learner progress and feedback to continuously optimize the effectiveness of your training solutions.

About the team

As part of the Amazon Logistics organization, the Learning & Development team plays a important role in empowering our frontline workforce to deliver an exceptional customer experience. Our mission is to design and deploy world‑class training solutions that drive operational excellence, ensure process adherence, and foster a culture of continuous improvement.

Basic Qualifications

  • Completed Bachelor’s Degree
  • Experience with L&D Content Creation Tools to develop educational programs and curriculum
  • Experience with Learning Management System (LMS) and Learning Design System (LDS)
  • Fluent Portuguese

Preferred Qualifications

  • Operations Background
  • Intermediate English
  • Certifications in Instructional Design

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: ANALISTA SISTEMAS - HOSPITAL CARDOSO FONTES
description:
A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04 / 03 / 1966, 40.103 de 17 / 05 / 1962 e 8.911, de 30 / 07 / 1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Valores

  • Profissionalismo
  • Qualidade
  • Responsabilidade Social
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Ética

Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia da Computação, Ciências da Computação e áreas afins. Pós-Graduação na área de atuação.

Experiência de 6 meses na função.

Ser responsável pelo alinhamento entre as áreas de negócios e Tecnologia e Informação. Oferecer suporte aos usuários quanto ao uso de sistemas. Realizar análises e correções em sistemas. Analisar as solicitações e acompanhamento das empresas terceirizadas. Dimensionar requisitos e funcionalidades do sistema. Desenvolver relatórios a partir dos bancos de dados dos sistemas.

To be considered for this role, at a minimum the candidate must possess the following licenses and/or training, which will have at least 6 additional months of validity at the time of CV submittal:

  • OGUK or STCW compliant Health Certificate.
  • Basic Safety Training (OPITO approved BOSIET, STCW Basic Training w/HUET, or CBSP w/HUET is the minimum requirement).
  • IWCF Well Control, Driller, Combined, Level 3 (note: some training schools are not acceptable; Seadrill will make final determination upon reviewing candidate’s credentials).

  • Special Requirements/Restrictions to be listed here.
  • If this section is blank, no additional or special requirements other than standard industry experience for the role and rig type.

1.0 VACANCY REQUIREMENTS

JOB TITLE: Driller

REPORTING TO: Toolpusher/Tourpusher

LOCATION: Offshore

1.1 ROLE SUMMARY

Responsible for the safe and efficient execution of all well and drilling activities and actively supervise the drilling crew.

1.2 QHSE Responsibilities

  • Compliance with the Seadrill Code of Conduct.
  • Compliance with applicable internal and external governing requirements.
  • Compliance with applicable laws.
  • All relevant personnel trained in handling emergencies.
  • Emergency equipment in good condition and configured as required.
  • Non‑compliances promptly acted on and reported.
  • Relevant governing documents revised as required.
  • Compliance with standard for tidiness and cleanliness.
  • Assume the safety role as per station bill and emergency preparedness plan.
  • Contribute with OBS card reporting.

Assist With

  • Verifying client drilling program versus Seadrill requirements.
  • Seadrill training, certification and competence compliance management.

Participate In

  • Meeting activities in a proactive and constructive manner.
  • Training and competence assessments as assigned and/or required.

1.3 JOB SPECIFIC Responsibilities

  • Owner of well integrity at all times.
  • Direct all drilling activities in accordance with the drilling program.
  • Monitor the wellbore condition, interpret and respond to downhole conditions.
  • Secure the well during an emergency or well control situation.
  • Execute well kill operations as per Seadrill supervisors’ instructions.
  • Conduct well and drilling activities as directed by the Tool/Tour pusher.
  • The drill floor is never left unattended when connected to a well.
  • All relevant governing documents adhered to by direct reports.
  • Clear daily operational guidelines provided to all direct reports.
  • Visible leadership by spending time in the field and monitoring daily operations.
  • All drills and checks conducted as required.
  • All applicable reports and logs submitted to supervisors, client, and company.
  • Assist with preparation for future drilling operations.
  • Thorough handovers at each daily change of shift.
  • Subordinates trained for higher positions.
  • Other duties performed as directed by the direct supervisor.

1.4 EQUIPMENT & SYSTEMS

  • Operational preparedness of all safety and emergency equipment.
  • First line maintenance of drilling equipment performed and recorded.

1.5 AUTHORITY

  • As per Corporate and Regional specific Delegation of Authority matrices.

1.6 QUALIFICATIONS

  • As per Seadrill training and competence directives.

2.0 REGIONAL REQUIREMENTS

This section describes requirements deemed necessary for this position in the respective region and are considered as additions to the requirements outlined in Section 1. The requirements in Section 1 are considered minimum corporate requirements and deviations from these are handled in accordance with the Directive for Handling of Non-conformities.

Personnel Requirements

All candidates who pass initial CV screening and possess the basic certifications and licenses must complete online psychometric assessments prior to any further screening or interviews. The results will be used by Seadrill as part of overall screening. Candidates will be notified via email if they are chosen to take the assessment. The assessment must be completed within 5 days to ensure efficient and timely screening. If the candidate cannot take the assessment within this time period, please let Seadrill know.

Additional Requirements

  • Strong leadership and communication ability.
  • Good ability to speak, read, and write English.
  • Strong sense of accountability and ownership for performance and safety of crew and rig.

Employment Details

  • Seniority level: Not applicable.
  • Employment type: Full‑time.
  • Job function: Management and Manufacturing.
  • Industries: Oil and Gas.

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. title: Compliance Analyst
description:
About Crown

We exist to make money work better. That means eliminating the friction of integrating the Brazilian Real into the blockchain economy without sacrificing trust, safety, or compliance.

With the conviction that programmable money is the future of finance, we built BRLV . Anchored by a 1:1 backing of sovereign Brazilian treasury assets, BRLV is the safe, scalable settlement layer designed for the tokenized economy.

We’re backed by Framework, Valor, Norte, Coinbase Ventures, Paxos, and Nubank co‑founder Ed Wible. Our goal: R$1 trillion of BRLV in circulation within 10 years.

The Role

As a Compliance Analyst at Crown, you will be a cornerstone of our risk management framework, operating across both the first and second lines of defense. You will serve as the primary compliance liaison for our institutional clients and partners, guiding them through our rigorous due diligence process while performing critical risk analysis to protect the firm. This role requires a unique blend of client‑facing communication skills and deep analytical rigor. You will work directly with the Chief Compliance Officer and the broader risk function to implement and uphold our institutional‑grade AML/CFT Policy.

  • Institutional Onboarding (1st Line): Act as the main point of contact for institutional clients during the entire onboarding lifecycle. You will guide them through the appropriate Due Diligence Questionnaire (for Brazilian, U.S., or other non‑U.S. entities), ensuring all mandatory documentation—such as constitutional documents, AML/CFT policies, and ownership charts—is collected completely and accurately.
  • Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and Risk Assessment (2nd Line): Conduct comprehensive reviews of prospective clients, applying our risk‑based approach. This includes analyzing complex corporate structures to identify and verify Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBOs) according to our dynamic thresholds.
  • Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD): Execute enhanced due diligence for high‑risk clients, including Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), VASPs, and other financial institutions. This involves a critical assessment of the client’s own AML program, their independent audit reports, and the source of their funds and wealth.
  • Transaction Monitoring Support (2nd Line): Assist in the analysis of alerts generated by our on‑chain and fiat transaction monitoring systems. You will investigate atypical activity, adhering to strict internal SLAs for resolution (e.g., 24 hours for critical alerts), and prepare dossiers for potential Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) to be submitted to COAF.
  • Record Keeping and Data Protection: Ensure all due diligence, risk assessments, and client communications are meticulously documented and securely stored, in compliance with our policies and regulatory requirements. You will handle highly sensitive client data and must adhere strictly to our Information Security Policy and data protection principles (LGPD).

You Might Be a Fit If...

  • You have 3+ years of experience in a compliance, KYC/AML, risk, or client onboarding role within a VASP, fintech, or regulated financial institution.
  • You have a deep and practical understanding of Brazilian AML/CFT regulations (e.g., Law 14.478/22, COAF reporting) and are familiar with international FATF standards.
  • You are fluent in both Portuguese and English, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills required to interact with sophisticated institutional clients and internal stakeholders.
  • You have a highly analytical mindset and an obsessive attention to detail, capable of dissecting complex legal and corporate structures to identify underlying risks.
  • You thrive in ownership-driven environments. You’re highly accountable for your work and don’t require others following up on it.
  • You naturally operate cross-functionally, with strong collaborative instincts toward legal, operations, and technology teams.
  • You are energized by the challenge of building and refining compliance processes from the ground up in a fast-paced environment.

What’s Different About Working Here

  • Small by design. We don’t hire layers of managers. Everyone builds.
  • Ownership is total. You own the function end‑to‑end—and ask for input when it makes the work better, not because someone’s checking.
  • Ruthlessly simple. We don’t paper over complexity with process or headcount.
  • Collaboration is default. Problems are shared property. We work across domains.
  • Feedback is candid and direct. Built on the assumption that everyone here is smart, competent, and cares.

Compensation

  • Competitive salary
  • Full health coverage
  • VA

description:

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million and in line to exceed US$200 million in FY25, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL's evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.

Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator ("MVNO") in ten countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 15 countries.

Position Overview

1Global is seeking a talented and detail-oriented RoamingIREG Engineer to manage the entire roaming process and procedures. As an IREG Engineer you will be responsible for the technical setup, testing, and maintenance of international roaming and interconnect services.

We're looking for a proactive individual with a strong technical foundation, adept at troubleshooting support cases and enhancing operational processes for seamless footprint updates.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and document IREG tests (IR.24, IR.35, IR.50, etc.) for voice, SMS, and data services, in line with GSMA standards
  • Set up and verify interconnect links for voice and messaging services with partner operators
  • Monitor roaming service KPIs, troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with roaming agreements
  • Configure and test SS7, Diameter, SIP, and related signaling protocols for international connectivity
  • Liaise with foreign operators, roaming hubs, and internal teams during implementation and troubleshooting
  • Maintain up-to-date test results, network configurations, and operational procedures
  • Oversee the footprint management of all 1Global products, working closely with the wholesale and other networks team

Requirements

Must Have

  • Perform end-to-end roaming testing (voice, SMS, data, CAMEL, VoLTE, 5G roaming)
  • Execute IREG test cases according to GSMA guidelines and bilateral agreements
  • Analyze and troubleshoot roaming issues with signaling traces and logs
  • Work closely with international roaming partners to resolve interconnect problems
  • Manage and update roaming documentation (IR.21)
  • Support new roaming launches (testing and activation of new operators, technologies, and services)
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Core Network, Billing, etc) during testing and troubleshooting
  • Validate TAP files and charging/billing aspects of roaming services
  • Monitor KPIs and performance of roaming services after launch
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators for the entire roaming service
  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers
  • Have successful partnerships with other departments and teams

Qualifications

  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, ETSI, standards and specifications for SIM/eSIM
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as MAP, S6a
  • Familiar with an RSP architecture and experience operating it
  • Knowledge in scripting and have basic programming skills
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot network errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape

Benefits

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses — to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

title: Shipboard Medispa Physician
description:
This position is based on a Cruise Ship

Education and Experience Requirements

  • Completed medical education and hold a medical degree from a recognized college or university.
  • Hold a current valid medical license.
  • Board certification or similar international certification in Plastic Surgery or Dermatology preferred but not required.
  • Comfortable with giving presentations/speaking in front of large groups.
  • Fluency in English.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.

Reports to: Spa Manager

Job Summary

The Medi-Spa Physician administers cosmetic medical procedures to on onboard guests. They must possess the clinical knowledge to administer these procedures, safely and effectively, and be able to explain accurately all aspects of the products and services, to the guests. They must have excellent communication skills and be able to provide aesthetic medical solutions, safely and effectively, to address the concerns of on board guests. The Medi-Spa Physicians are expected to work with The Medi-Spa Sales Consultant, who will assist them with the sales, marketing, and promotional aspects of the position. The Medi–Spa Sales Consultant will also translate for the Medi-Spa Physicians if necessary. The Medi-Spa Physicians are expected to gain the knowledge of the spa services and products in effort to cross-promote these services to guests. The Medi-Spa Physician will review and give final approval for all service/treatment plans organized and booked by the Medi – Spa Sales Consultant. Position requirements Possess the ability to work without direct supervision and actively promote the services to the guests Work closely with the Medi–Spa Sales Consultant Must have enthusiasm and possess excellent customer service skills Must be able to give an effective presentation as it relates to medi-spa services Enjoy working with people and possess a friendly and outgoing personality Excellent communication and listening skills Basic computer knowledge Must be a team player

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Be on time for work, prompt for each appointment.
  • Provide consistent professional medi-spa services and treatments in accordance with OneSpaWorld’s medi-spa protocols.
  • Conduct patient follow-up as required.
  • Be flexible with scheduling, supporting the needs of the spa and guest.
  • Properly care for equipment and use proper amounts of product/supplies to assist with cost control
  • Follow service pricing policy set by OneSpaWorld.
  • Prior to all services, complete with the guest the Medical Record which must be stored at the completion of each cruise in the Spa Manager’s office or designated place within the spa facilities for a period of 2 years. (3 years on Cunard and P&O).
  • Cross-promote other spa services.
  • Uphold the standards of sanitation and sterilization as directed by ship and company policy and procedure. Properly clean and restock medi-spa treatment room as required.
  • Manage medical product and supply inventory.
  • Communicate to management any and all occurrences involving staff or guests in the spa that require attention.
  • Handle guests’ questions and concerns professionally and courteously.
  • Provide accurate, appropriate and immediate responses to all requests by guests.
  • Maintain a positive attitude and contribute toward a quality work environment.
  • Regularly attend, participate in and support training and staff meetings for the spa.
  • Required team meetings: embarkation day meetings and sea day team meetings.
  • Assist in all areas of spa operation as requested by management.
  • Train new spa staff in medi-spa services/cross-promotion skills – follow up must be carried out to ensure staff are confident with services and promotions.
  • Follow Medi-Spa Operations Policies.
  • Email report daily and inventory report with every end of cruise report.
  • For all guests, doctors must review the guest consultation information with them prior to the service.
  • All guests receiving treatments (including complimentary treatments) must complete the required consent forms. Doctors are required to complete a medical record for each guest.
  • At conclusion of the treatment, review Aftercare Instructions with the guest and provide them with a copy. Conclude by thanking the guest for the opportunity to take care of them. Schedule a follow-up appointment and assist them with scheduling at the front desk.
  • Clean your room and set up for your next guest.
  • Do not stand around the front desk between services. Treatment room should look the same at the start and end of every day and between each guest. This means the room must be:
  • Clean – sanitize work surfaces and sink area; store trash is proper receptacles.
  • biohazard/sharps/trash: All trash must be taken out daily or when full.
  • Organized – stock boxes should be out of sight and all supplies must be organized or stored properly
  • Inviting – the treatment bed must be properly dressed and proper ambience with regards to music and temperature. End of Day Checklist
  • Dispose of open unused needles
  • Dispose of Bio-Hazard bag if full
  • Take Sharps Container to Medical facility if full
  • Sterilize table and countertops
  • Fill out inventory control form
  • Lock product storage cabinets
  • Lock treatment room
  • Email daily revenue report to shore side team
  • Service booking policy: A clean, non-intimidating, state-of-the-art and stress-free environment is not only what we strive to offer our guests, it is the goal for our staff as well. It will not only hurt the business of our spa but will affect your individual success in this industry. Following are some policies that we have put in place to help us avoid unnecessary contention:
  • Medi-Spa Physicians may only be booked for services for which they are qualified to administer.
  • In some cases, it is impossible to fairly book services if you are not qualified to perform all services.
  • Medi-Spa Physicians are not allowed to refuse or trade services that they are certified to perform. Guest requests cannot be moved or changed without the Spa Manager’s approval. All staff members are required to perform general duties during their scheduled hours, as directed by the manager onboard. General duties may include, but are not limited to, promotional duties, port cleaning, staff meetings, training and stock inventory. Please be guided by your Spa Manager’s instructions. Guidelines for Protection and Sanitization (GPS)
  • Be familiar with OneSpaWorld’s ‘GPS’ to safety.
  • Understand and practice the required self-screening procedures.
  • Understand and follow the agreed upon procedures for symptomatic guests or employees.
  • Understand and adhere to staff and guest Physical Distancing Policy.
  • Understand and adhere to Staff Personal Hygiene Policy.
  • Understand and adhere to the Hand Washing Policy.
  • Arrive at the spa between five and ten minutes prior to assigned shift start time. Understand proper use and disposal of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for the modality and for handling soiled linen, waste, and chemicals.
  • Be familiar with the approved disinfecting products available at the spa location including proper use, contact time, disinfection methods and proper storage and handling procedures.
  • Understand and adhere to the Treatment Room Preparation requirements.
  • Understand and adhere to the Sanitation Policy for the applicable modality and services performed.
  • Understand and adhere to the Sanitation Policy for the applicable spa area.
  • Understand the Sanitation Log Policy and complete logs as required.
  • Understand and adhere to the Retail Product Handling and Transferring Procedure.
  • Understand and adhere to the Product Sampling Procedure.

    • Treinar os operadores de produção, modelistas e outros profissionais envolvidos na fabricação sobre os processos e padrões exigidos.
  7. Sustentabilidade e Conformidade
    • Trabalhar para implementar práticas de produção mais sustentáveis, selecionando materiais ecológicos e otimizando processos para reduzir desperdícios.

O(a) Coordenador(a) de Projetos será responsável por liderar e garantir a execução eficiente de projetos técnicos e multidisciplinares no segmento naval e offshore. Este profissional será o elo entre cliente, equipe técnica e demais stakeholders, assegurando que escopo, prazo, custo e qualidade sejam cumpridos com excelência. Sua atuação inclui desde a definição e acompanhamento do escopo até a entrega final, com participação ativa em propostas, planejamento, execução e controle dos projetos.

Rotina de trabalho:

Trabalhar na Proper Marine é integrar uma equipe multidisciplinar altamente qualificada, com foco em excelência técnica, inovação e segurança. Nosso ambiente estimula a troca de conhecimento, o desenvolvimento contínuo e a entrega de soluções eficientes, com espaço para autonomia, criatividade e crescimento profissional. A atuação do Coordenador de Projetos é estratégica para garantir a fluidez entre áreas, a satisfação do cliente e a solidez dos resultados.

Formação e experiência:

Formação e experiência:

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia Mecânica, Civil, Naval ou áreas afins.

  • Experiência geral mínima de 4 a 5 anos em empresas do setor naval, offshore ou de engenharia.

  • Experiência mínima de 1 a 2 anos com coordenação e gestão de projetos técnicos na área naval, offshore ou em empresas de óleo e gás.

Principais responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Planejar, coordenar e controlar projetos multidisciplinares, assegurando o cumprimento de prazos, orçamentos e padrões técnicos.

  • Atuar como principal ponto de contato entre clientes, fornecedores e equipe interna, garantindo comunicação fluida e alinhamento de expectativas.

  • Elaborar e revisar cronogramas, escopos técnicos, propostas comerciais e relatórios gerenciais.

  • Participar da definição de soluções técnicas, interagindo com engenheiros, projetistas e demais áreas envolvidas.

  • Realizar reuniões periódicas de alinhamento com o cliente (interno ou externo), acompanhando marcos e atualizações.

  • Controlar riscos, mudanças de escopo e garantir a documentação técnica dos projetos.

  • Apoiar em licitações, orçamentos e propostas, definindo estratégia técnica e comercial.

  • Realizar visitas técnicas, acompanhamentos de obra e verificação de escopo executado.

  • Colaborar ativamente com o time global da Longitude/ABL em projetos internacionais.

Habilidades Técnicas (Hard Skills):

  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de projetos (MS Project, pacote office avançado, etc.).

  • Conhecimento técnico em projetos navais, estruturas offshore, integração de sistemas e engenharia multidisciplinar.

  • Familiaridade com normas técnicas nacionais e internacionais, regulatórios da indústria naval/offshore.

  • Domínio de elaboração e acompanhamento de cronogramas, matriz de responsabilidades, controle de escopo e custo.

  • Experiência dando reports ao cliente e alta liderança, incluindo análise de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs).

  • Leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos, memoriais descritivos, contratos e escopo executivo.

Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills):

Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills):

  • Comunicação clara e estratégica: habilidade para se comunicar com diferentes perfis, inclusive com níveis hierárquicos variados dentro dos clientes.

  • Organização e priorização: capacidade de lidar com múltiplos projetos e prazos simultâneos.

  • Liderança colaborativa: saber guiar sem impor, ouvindo o time e garantindo fluidez entre áreas técnicas.

  • Perfil mão na massa: autonomia, iniciativa e disposição para assumir responsabilidades e tomar decisões.

  • Postura profissional e empática: condução firme, porém respeitosa, diante de desafios, conflitos ou mudanças de escopo.

Advert 2H Offshore is a global engineering contractor specializing in the design, engineering and integrity management of offshore structures, topsides facilities, subsea components and riser and conductor systems for the offshore oil and gas and renewables sectors. Both market sectors require similar engineering skill sets, and our breadth of experience in offshore structures and environments allows us to provide expertise at all stages of a project: feasibility and concept design, detailed design, procurement management, fabrication support, installation support, monitoring, integrity management, asset life extension and decommissioning.
2H Offshore is seeking an experienced Document Controller to join our team and support large-scale subsea engineering projects. The ideal candidate will take ownership of document control processes, ensuring compliance with internal standards and client requirements. This is not an administrative role—we need someone with proven expertise in document management systems, document lifecycle workflows, and quality assurance protocols, who can proactively support project teams and contribute to efficient project execution.
The successful candidate will be based in the Rio de Janeiro area.
**Please submit Resumes/CVs in English.
Duties
•Implement and manage document control procedures aligned with company and client standards
•Maintain accurate records of incoming and outgoing documentation, including engineering deliverables, technical reports, and correspondence
•Ensure version control, document traceability, and appropriate metadata tagging across all project files
•Coordinate with engineering, procurement, project management, and external stakeholders to manage document workflows and approvals
•Monitor document deadlines and ensure timely distribution of critical information
•Conduct regular audits to verify compliance and data integrity
•Train team members on document control systems and best practices as required
•Interface with client document control systems, ensuring consistency and alignment
•Support preparation of project handovers, final documentation, and close-out packages
Required
•Proven experience as a document controller in the oil & gas or offshore engineering sector, ideally with exposure to subsea projects
•Strong understanding of document control standards, numbering systems, and ISO-based procedures
•Proficiency in document management platforms (e.g., SharePoint, Aconex, OpenText, or client-specific DMS)
•Strong communication skills in English
•Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills
•Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, technical environment
•Familiarity with engineering terminology and project documentation (e.g., drawings, MTOs, technical specs)
•Degree or diploma in engineering, administration, or related field is preferred

title: Email Marketing Associate
description:
Join to apply for the Email Marketing Associate role at Darkroom .

About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. Founded in 2017 out of a conviction that iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different, Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results‑driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and earned esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring an Email Marketing Specialist – a sharp, creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, conversion, and customer retention. This is not a plug‑and‑play execution role; it requires a high level of ownership, creative problem‑solving, and a strong grasp of lifecycle marketing strategy. You’ll partner closely with Retention Managers and designers to develop and deploy high‑performing email and SMS campaigns for some of the fastest‑growing DTC brands in the world. From ideation and copywriting to QA and reporting, you'll be hands‑on throughout the lifecycle, translating insights into messages that drive revenue, deepen loyalty, and elevate the customer experience.

Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.

Fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Argentina, Colombia and Mexico.

A Day in the Life

  • Work directly with a Retention Marketing Manager to execute data‑driven email and SMS strategies for our DTC/e‑commerce clients.
  • On a daily basis, you will execute tasks for clients including writing, proofing, and scheduling email and SMS campaigns.
  • You’ll work directly with clients to manage the revision and approval process of their emails and SMS messages.
  • On a monthly basis, you’ll develop creative campaign concepts for your client's retention marketing calendars.
  • You’ll work directly with our in‑house design team to develop the design approach, ensuring the design vision for campaigns and flows comes to life, and managing the revision and approval process for client emails.
  • You’ll produce the copy for your campaign concepts and work directly with the client to gain approval on briefs before sending them to our in‑house designers.
  • Driven and enjoy coming to the team and clients with new retention marketing ideas.
  • Execute automation/flow logic set‑up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.

Who You Are

We're looking for an Email Marketing Specialist to join our team! In this role, you will write email and SMS marketing copy, build and deploy email and SMS flows and campaigns, and develop content for our e‑commerce, DTC clients.

  • You’re passionate about developing creative email and SMS marketing copy that drives loyalty and lifetime value for e‑commerce clients.
  • You have experience working in Klaviyo or a similar ESP.
  • You’re passionate about marketing, and especially interested in learning and growing in the DTC and e‑commerce marketing industry.
  • You’re a creative and experienced writer and looking to grow your career in marketing copywriting.
  • You're used to working in a fast‑paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.
  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.

You Should Apply If This Sounds Like You

  • 2‑4 years of work experience in digital marketing, copywriting, growth marketing, e‑commerce, etc.
  • Past experience working at an agency or working with multiple clients in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Experience working with Klaviyo or similar email service providers.
  • Enthusiastic, passionate, and creative; thrives on thinking outside the box to create new best‑in‑class customer experiences.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus the ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. With hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, São Paulo, and Barcelona!
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Fundada em 20 de agosto de 1972, a Unimed do Estado do Rio de Janeiro – Federação Estadual das Cooperativas Médicas (Unimed Ferj) atua há 52 anos como representante estatutária de todas as Unimeds do estado. Ao longo de sua trajetória, a Unimed Ferj tem desempenhado um papel fundamental na promoção da conformidade regulatória e na implementação das melhores práticas de gestão entre as cooperativas do sistema Unimed no Rio de Janeiro.

Com uma governança corporativa voltada para a sustentabilidade e uma cultura organizacional focada em pessoas, a Unimed Ferj é uma referência no Sistema Unimed fluminense, que gera aproximadamente 16 mil empregos diretos e conta com uma ampla rede credenciada. Esses fatores contribuem para que o Sistema Unimed seja reconhecido como referência em Saúde Suplementar no Brasil.

Na função de Operadora de plano de saúde, a Unimed Ferj se dedica a oferecer um atendimento de excelência a mais de 470 mil clientes, por meio de uma ampla rede de médicos cooperados, unidades próprias e serviços credenciados.

Desde abril de 2024, a Unimed Ferj assumiu a gestão, o dimensionamento estrutural e o direcionamento assistencial do Hospital Unimed e dos Prontos Atendimentos Unimed na cidade do Rio de Janeiro. Nas unidades próprias, são mais de 2.400 profissionais comprometidos e dedicados a oferecer um cuidado humanizado e de excelência aos nossos pacientes.

Buscamos pessoas que valorizam as relações humanas e abraçam novas oportunidades. Na Rede Própria da Unimed Ferj, promovemos a diversidade, respeitamos diferentes ideias e perspectivas, e vivemos os princípios do cooperativismo, sempre com foco na excelência do cuidado.

description:
Join to apply for the ENFERMEIRO EDUCACAO PERMANENTE - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Elaborar e implantar programas de desenvolvimento e capacitação dos empregados, com o propósito de auxiliar os mesmos no atingimento das metas e objetivos estabelecidos pela Instituição.

Com experiências imersivas e coletivas, irá reunir as muitas Amazônias, nacionais e internacionais, e aproximar os vários setores sociais para debater os temas da área.

Além dos museus, temos também a gestão do Fundo da Mata Atlântica e atuamos na revitalização do Cais do Valongo-RJ .

Nosso propósito é : Esperançar futuros possíveis

  • Compromisso com excelência: Fazemos sempre o nosso melhor. Nos orgulhamos de estabelecer boas relações com nossos parceiros, colaboradores e todas as pessoas que estão na nossa rede, e de criar espaços encantadores de reflexão e conhecimento.

Faça parte de uma das principais companhias independentes de Óleo & Gás.

Venha crescer com a gente!

Missão da vaga:

  • Graduação em Engenharia Mecânica, Elétrica, Produção, Naval ou similar.

  • Experiência com gestão de equipes multidisciplinares (elétrica, mecânica, instrumentação, utilidades, caldeiraria).
  • Planejamento e execução de manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva com priorização por criticidade.
  • Planejamento integrado de paradas de produção, elaboração/avaliação de pacotes de serviço e interface com operações.
  • Gestão de backlog, sobressalentes críticos, estoque e lead time de materiais.
  • Condução de RCA (Root Cause Analysis), planos de ação e melhoria contínua.
  • Interface com contratadas, fornecedores, inspeção, SMS, logística e suprimentos.

title: Field Compliance Coordinator - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
description:
Field Compliance Coordinator - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

Position : Field Compliance Coordinator with full relocation to Saudi Arabia as a permanent full‑time expatriate. Attractive relocation package. Qualified candidates will be contacted.

Position Description

We are seeking a Field Compliance Coordinator to join our Upstream OE & Compliance Division. The Division is responsible for providing safety support to Upstream Executive Management and various organizations through HSE reporting, safety audits, recommendations, human‑factor guidance, training, major incident investigations, and lessons‑learned creation. Your primary role will support upstream organizations on Process Safety and major incident investigations for onshore and offshore drilling and oil & gas processing plants.

Key Responsibilities

  • Enhance safety standards and procedures such as work permits, process safety, hazard identification, risk management, and emergency preparedness.
  • Develop loss‑prevention, fire‑prevention, and safety standards, procedures, and General Instructions (GIs) for matters not covered by existing resources.
  • Consult with upstream management to facilitate Safety Management System (SMS) enhancement.
  • Create critical safety documents for major activities such as job safety analyses and hazard identification plans.
  • Assist departments in preparing for major safety reviews, including loss‑prevention compliance reviews.
  • Research emerging safety technologies and conduct feasibility studies and cost analyses to identify improved solutions for existing safety problems and regulatory requirements.
  • Act as a process‑safety audit expert during design, construction, commissioning, turnover to operations, ongoing operations, change management, and decommissioning.
  • Develop and deliver safety training material and safe‑work procedures to field personnel.
  • Instruct on safety concepts, practices, and standards (both on‑the‑job and classroom).
  • Direct and participate in preparing major reference manuals documenting corporate and LP safety systems, policies, and procedures (e.g., LP Policy, SMS manual, Safety Handbook, Construction Safety Manual).
  • Facilitate and lead incident investigations, including interviewing witnesses, gathering data, and conducting root‑cause analysis.
  • Facilitate and lead safety audits by identifying non‑compliance with occupational health and safety regulations and advising on improvements.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, HSE, or an equivalent accredited program.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in upstream organizations spanning exploration, drilling, and production on both onshore and offshore sites, with at least 5 years in a senior loss‑prevention or fire‑prevention role.
  • Strong technical expertise in process safety disciplines such as design engineering, loss control management, hazard identification, HAZOP reviews, incident investigations, emergency preparedness, response, and safety management systems.
  • Experience with HAZOP and SIL studies is preferred; internationally recognized certifications are advantageous.

Working Environment

Our high‑performing employees are drawn by challenging and rewarding professional, technical, and industrial opportunities, and are remunerated accordingly.

Benefits

Permanent expatriate relocation package, competitive compensation, and opportunities for career development within a global energy leader.

Dá uma olhada no seu papel nessa #revolução:

  • Liderar e desenvolver a criação de um sistema conversacional com IA generativa (LLM);
  • Projetar arquitetura escalável e segura com integração aos sistemas da Trinks;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times de Produto, UX, Dados e Engenharia;
  • Implementar soluções baseadas em RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) com foco em contexto e precisão;

  • Conhecimento de arquitetura em nuvem (preferencialmente AWS);

title: Analista de Suporte N2 – Redes
description:
Sobre a empresa

Somos um provedor de internet em crescimento, focado em qualidade, estabilidade e atendimento próximo aos nossos clientes.
Buscamos um Analista N2 Pleno para cuidar da parte técnica da rede e apoiar a expansão da empresa.

Missão do cargo

Garantir que a rede funcione de forma estável , resolvendo problemas técnicos de clientes e da infraestrutura, atuando entre o atendimento N1 e a engenharia/N3 .

Atividades principais

  • Atender chamados escalados pelo N1 (casos que o N1 não conseguiu resolver).
  • Analisar conectividade :
    • Testes de ping e traceroute (IP e domínio).
    • Identificar se o problema está no cliente, na rede interna, no POP, na rota ou na operadora.
  • Acessar e analisar OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia ou similar):
    • Ver potência RX/TX das ONUs.
    • Ver ONUs flutuando (online/offline).
    • Verificar erros e utilização das portas GPON.
  • Verificar e ajustar VLAN, PPPoE, IPoE e DHCP :
    • Sessões PPPoE travadas.
    • Cliente autenticando e não navegando.
    • Cliente sem IP ou recebendo IP incorreto.
  • Apoiar o time de campo com diagnóstico técnico (indicar provável ponto de falha).
  • Utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento (Zabbix, Grafana ou similares) para identificar e prevenir instabilidades.
  • Registrar nos chamados o passo a passo do diagnóstico e da solução .

Requisitos técnicos (obrigatórios)

  • Experiência prévia em provedor de internet ou suporte de redes .
  • Bom conhecimento de TCP/IP (IP, máscara, gateway, DNS, rota).
  • Entender bem PPPoE e/ou IPoE .
  • Saber trabalhar com VLAN (ACCESS/TRUNK, tagged/untagged).
  • Noções sólidas de IPv4 e NAT.
  • Uso prático de ping , tracert/traceroute e testes por IP e domínio.
  • Conhecimento básico em ao menos um equipamento de borda, por exemplo: Mikrotik, Cisco, Huawei ou similar .
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de logs (roteador, OLT, servidor PPPoE/DHCP).

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios, mas contam ponto)

  • Experiência com OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de CGNAT / BNG / BRAS .
  • Experiência com Zabbix, Grafana ou outras ferramentas de monitoramento.
  • Noções de IPv6 .
  • Cursos ou certificações em redes (MTCNA, CCNA , etc.).
  • Já trabalhou em provedor de internet.
  • Sabe mexer em OLT GPON na prática (ver potência, ONU, porta, erros).
  • Usa Mikrotik ou similar no dia a dia.
  • Consegue resolver a maioria dos problemas sem supervisão.
  • Já trabalhou com redes/provedor.
  • Conhece TCP/IP, PPPoE, VLAN.
  • Atua com OLT GPON + Mikrotik + monitoramento (Zabbix/Grafana) .
  • Entende bem PPPoE, IPoE, VLAN, NAT, CGNAT/BNG .
  • Consegue segurar plantão e dar suporte ao time como referência técnica.

Perfil comportamental

  • Gosta de resolver problema até o fim , sem “empurrar para o outro”.
  • Sabe trabalhar sob pressão, mantendo calma e foco.Boa comunicação com N1, N3 e técnicos de campo .
  • Organização para registrar tudo o que faz.
  • Vontade de aprender e crescer junto com a empresa .

Jornada / Modelo

  • Regime: CLT – 44h semanais
  • Horário: segunda a sexta, das 09h às 17h
  • Sábado, das 09h às 13h
  • Local: Av Ayrton Senna 3000, Edíficio Itanhanga (Via Parque) – Presencial

title: ENGENHEIRO TÉCNICO DE PRODUTO FOCO EM BIQUINI
description:
Estamos com uma posição para Engenheiro técnico de produto com foco em biquíni. Suas atividades estarão voltadas para o desenvolvimento, melhoria e controle de qualidade de produtos têxteis, atuando em diversas etapas do processo de criação e fabricação, garantindo que os produtos atendam aos requisitos técnicos e de mercado.

Atribuições e responsabilidades:

  1. Análise e Desenvolvimento de Produto
    • Desenvolver protótipos de novos produtos, considerando o design, materiais, funcionalidades e estética.
    • Elaborar fichas técnicas detalhadas com todas as especificações do produto (materiais, cores, tamanhos, acabamentos, técnicas de costura, etc.).
    • Avaliar e selecionar materiais adequados para cada tipo de produto, garantindo qualidade e adequação à funcionalidade do design.
  2. Processo de Produção
    • Definir os processos produtivos necessários para fabricar os produtos conforme os requisitos de qualidade e prazos estabelecidos.
    • Ajustar padrões de produção, como cortes, modelagem e costura, para garantir que o produto final atenda às especificações.
    • Monitorar o andamento da produção, identificar possíveis problemas técnicos e sugerir soluções para otimizar o processo.
  3. Controle de Qualidade
    • Realizar inspeções durante e após a produção para verificar se os produtos atendem aos padrões de qualidade estabelecidos.
    • Coordenar ou realizar testes de durabilidade, resistência, lavagem e outros parâmetros técnicos para assegurar a conformidade do produto final.
    • Identificar e tratar desvios de qualidade, propondo melhorias ou ajustes nos processos produtivos ou de design.
  4. Ajustes e Melhorias Contínuas
    • Coletar feedback de clientes, áreas de vendas e outras partes envolvidas para identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos produtos.
    • Propor melhorias no processo de produção visando reduzir custos, melhorar a eficiência e garantir a qualidade.
    • Acompanhar inovações tecnológicas no setor têxtil e sugerir a implementação de novas técnicas ou equipamentos que melhorem o produto ou o processo produtivo.
  5. Gestão de Documentação Técnica
    • Atualizar constantemente as fichas técnicas, garantindo que as informações estejam corretas e acessíveis para as equipes de produção e comercialização.
    • Elaborar relatórios técnicos sobre o andamento do desenvolvimento de produtos, incluindo testes, qualidade e melhorias implementadas.
  6. Interação com Outras Áreas
    • Colaborar estreitamente com equipes de design e estilistas para garantir que as ideias criativas sejam viáveis do ponto de vista técnico e de produção.
    • Fornecer suporte técnico para a equipe comercial, ajudando a explicar os diferenciais e especificações dos produtos aos clientes ou consumidores.
    • Treinar os operadores de produção, modelistas e outros profissionais envolvidos na fabricação sobre os processos e padrões exigidos.
  7. Sustentabilidade e Conformidade
    • Trabalhar para implementar práticas de produção mais sustentáveis, selecionando materiais ecológicos e otimizando processos para reduzir desperdícios.
    • Garantir que os produtos atendam às normas de segurança, regulamentos ambientais e padrões internacionais de qualidade.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Ensino superior completo em Engenharia têxtil;

Experiência em varejo de moda, com foco em biquíni.

title: Completion Engineer (Lower Completion Specialist)
description:
Focusing on lower completions, this position will plan, design, and execute lower completion and gravel pack operations, provide offshore technical supervision, coordinate with wells, subsurface, and operations teams, and ensure proper well closeout and reporting.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare and present well design concepts based on information provided by Subsurface team
  • Assist with the preparation of cost estimates used to generate yearly Budgets and well/project specific AFE's
  • Forecast and accountable for the timely ordering of well/project specific Long Lead requirements
  • Contribute towards logistical coordination & quality assurance of services, materials, equipment and personnel
  • Integrate with fellow drilling, completion/testing, subsea and/or subsurface team members as required
  • Perform special studies/duties if/as required including conducting service quality meetings
  • Ensure Vendor service deficiencies are correctly and timely captured via the Company non-conformance reporting (NCR) process so as to ensure timely action/close out
  • Support NCR and root cause failure analysis as required
  • Contributor to the development, management and updating of the Drilling Management System (DMS)
  • Ensure the DMS is followed during well planning, design, engineering, and execution and closeout activities
  • Ensure compliance with Company and Drilling & Completion policies, standards and approved procedures
  • Ensure compliance of Vendor supplied materials, equipment and services which includes review of design, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation
  • Support the preparation of HSE documents if/where required
  • Contribute and participate in the hazard identification process
  • Contribute and participate in well/project specific risk assessments and pre-job planning meetings
  • Assist with the evaluation of rig and 3rd party services for hazards, well integrity and assurance
  • Support Drilling Management if requested in ER roles and incident investigations

Well/Project Specific Duties

  • Design Reservoir Lower Completion for producer and injector wells across different assets within the company
  • Perform Torque & Drag analysis for deploying lower completions in long horizontal wells. Specify landing string and evaluate the requirement for swiveling devices
  • Provide engineering support as part of the wells team which includes lower completion sizing and design, GP pumping schedule, costing and assisting with operation execution, as well as the services associated with these activities
  • Establish well/project life cycle functional and operational requirements, including material & equipment selection
  • Identify special Engineering Studies to be performed
  • Prepare well/project specific technical notes if/when required
  • Prepare detailed scopes of work for tender documents, perform vendor capability assessments, evaluate tenders methodically and capable of presenting a succinct recommendation
  • Raise Requisitions & Purchase Orders
  • Ensure compliance of Vendor supplied goods, materials, equipment and services which includes but is not limited to review of design, manufacturing processes, quality plans, post-manufacturing testing/verification, site receipt acceptance, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation
  • Review all applicable operating, installing & testing procedures, including interface documents
  • Contribute and participate in DWOP/CWOP as part of well/project commencement
  • Assist with preparation of Management of Change (MOC) documents and conducting a risk assessment for those changes with relevant parties
  • Review field tickets and/or well invoices
  • Review the engineering focussed After Action Review (AAR) report and apply lessons learnt
  • Responsible for compilation of End of well Reports (EOWRs)

Requirements

Education

  • Degree qualification in Engineering
  • Well Control certification (IWCF) - Subsea/Surface Supervisor is considered an advantage

Experience

  • Experience in Lower Completion and GP Pumping engineering
  • Experience with lower completion and sand control designs and execution
  • Experience with Alternate Path GP pumping technology is considered an advantage
  • Knowledge of appropriate and relevant well engineering tools (e.g. Landmark Suite (or similar) - Wellplan, Stresscheck, Compass, etc), and software packages
  • Knowledge of GP pumping software PackPro or similar

Job Details

  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Full-time
  • Job function: Project Management
  • Industries: IT Services and IT Consulting

title: Fund Accountant, Implementations
description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta is a platform that helps people manage equity, build businesses, and invest in the companies of tomorrow. Our mission is to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places.

Carta is trusted by more than 40,000 companies and over two million people in nearly 160 countries to manage cap tables, compensation, and valuations. Carta also supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, and represents nearly $130B in assets under administration. Carta's tender offer solutions have returned $14B to shareholders in secondary transactions. Today, Carta’s platform manages nearly three trillion dollars in equity globally.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As an Implementations Accountant, you will focus efforts on supporting new Fund Administration customers in their journey into Carta services. You work within our fast-growing Fund Administration business by coordinating, facilitating and managing onboarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline. You will:

  • Liaise between Sales and Fund Accounting teams as the bridge post-sales for new fund clients
  • Interact with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical accounting data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate financial statements to both the client and internal stakeholders
  • Book and reconcile all accounting books and records from, at times, unstructured client data. This includes reproducing Capital Calls, Distributions, Expenses, Investments, Management Fees, Financial Statements, and Partners’ Capital to match client sources.
  • Resolving escalations related to data migration, historical accounting discrepancies, and client onboarding issues
  • Manage all aspects of customer onboarding for medium to high complexity new clients by managing timelines, setting clear customer expectations, and completing all compliance procedures pre go-live
  • Build strong client relationships and provide a white glove experience by going on-site, anticipating client needs, and using Carta app capabilities effectively
  • Identify process and quality improvements, assist with internal reviews, Quality Assurance, and train junior team members
  • Sharing accounting and onboarding specificities with upstream teams for efficient post go-live fund administration

The Team You\u2019ll Work With

Our implementation accounting team acts as the bridge between sales and long term account management for new fund clients. The team ensures whatever information our clients had before joining Carta is correctly migrated into our system. Ours is a team of folks who have mastery of accounting, exhibit a high degree of problem-solving, efficiency, and integrity as they leverage their subject-matter expertise to provide customers with a world-class onboarding experience.

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience in an accounting role where you executed all aspects of end of quarter and year closes, preferably working within the Venture Capital Fund Administration environment
  • Strong accounting analysis skills with the ability to interpret a story through multiple years of unstructured data, and reproduce Financial Statements correctly
  • Ability to build strong client relationships through transparent and forthright communication. Able to manage multiple clients while hitting deadlines and providing white-glove service
  • Passionate about growing and advancing with Carta
  • Proven internal influencer having implemented and successfully managed both small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously

Salary

Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Our minimum cash compensation (salary + commission if applicable) range for this role is:

  • $102,000 - $120,000 in San Francisco, CA, Santa Clara, CA, and New York, NY
  • $96,900 - $114,000 in Seattle, WA

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the recruiter via email. As a company, we value fairness, helpfulness, transparency, leadership and build our teams around these values. Check out our careers page to get to know us better as you think about your next step at Carta.

Important Security Notice for Candidates

Our company has been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will come from an @carta.com domain. Be cautious of any requests for sensitive information or payments outside of our official channels. For more information about this type of scam, please review the guidelines provided by the Federal Trade Commission (FTC). If you encounter any suspicious activity, please report it immediately to

Awards and Acknowledgements

Companies and funds like Tribe and Pipe build their businesses on Carta. The company has been included on the Forbes World’s Best Cloud Companies, Fast Company\u2019s Most Innovative list, and Inc.’s Fastest-Growing Private Companies. We’ve also been recognized as a 2023 Built In Best Place to Work in the U.S., a Muse VIBE Award winner in the Vacation and Time Off category and certified as a Great Place to Work.

Interested in data privacy? Check out our policies on Privacy and CA Candidate Privacy.

description:
Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica - Rede Hospital Casa - CLT

Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores.

Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica que seja proativo, cuidadoso, dedicado e que tenha atenção e amor com seus processos de trabalho.

Suas principais atividades serão:

  • Assumir o posto de serviço conforme escala, devidamente identificado, uniformizado e com aparência pessoal adequada;
  • Identificar corretamente o paciente antes de realizar o procedimento;
  • Preparar paciente para procedimentos de imobilização ortopédica;
  • Preparar material para confeccionar as imobilizações;
  • Preparar sala para pequenos procedimentos fora do centro cirúrgico, como pequenas suturas e anestesia local para manobras de redução manual, punções e infiltrações;
  • Observar o tipo de imobilização a confeccionar, as condições do paciente, seguindo orientações e prescrição médica;
  • Confeccionar imobilizações e aparelhos gessados nas salas de gesso e cirurgia;
  • Confeccionar imobilizações com material sintético, aparelhos gessados, goteiras gessadas, esparadrapagem, talas digitais (imobilização para os dedos), enfaixamento, tração cutânea, colar cervical, entre outros, conforme prescrição médica;
  • Retirar aparelhos de imobilização ortopédica, conforme prescrição médica;
  • Utilizar de forma adequada equipamentos como serra elétrica vibratória;
  • Realizar procedimentos específicos em imobilizações ortopédicas, como a abertura de janelas no aparelho gessado;
  • Manter sala de imobilização organizada;
  • Zelar pela limpeza da sala, bem como organização e preservação e guarda de materiais e equipamentos de uso na sua especialidade;
  • Auxiliar o médico ortopedista em procedimentos ortopédicos não cirúrgicos, como na instalação de trações esqueléticas e manobras de redução manual;
  • Realizar lançamento e registro em prontuário dos procedimentos realizados e materiais utilizados;
  • Promover orientações pertinentes e de conservação da imobilização aos pacientes;
  • Auxiliar a equipe multidisciplinar em imobilizações de pacientes vítimas de trauma ou que necessitem de restrição total de movimento;
  • Obedecer às normas técnicas da Sociedade Brasileira de Ortopedia e Traumatologia (SBOT), às normas internacionais para confecção de imobilização, normas regulamentadoras de Segurança do Trabalho e o Código de Ética Profissional;
  • Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda e qualquer ocorrência administrativa;
  • Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda ocorrência durante atendimento ao paciente;
  • Participar de treinamentos institucional e setorial quando solicitado sua participação;
  • Cumprir as normas e regulamentos da Instituição, bem como as rotinas operacionais da sua Unidade;
  • Respeitar e conhecer os instrumentos normativos do setor como instruções de trabalho.

Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Ensino médio completo com curso técnico em imobilização ortopédica.
  • Registro no conselho de Classe.
  • Desejável experiência anterior de 06 meses.

What will you do as a Senior Software Test Designer?

As a Senior Software Test Designer, you’ll lead the development of automated tests and qualification tools. You’ll design and implement smart testing strategies, optimize processes, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless integration and continuous improvement. By mentoring junior engineers and acting as a sparring partner for customers, you’ll help raise the bar for quality and innovation.

  • Explore different solution approaches to achieve the best results.
  • Design, implement and optimize chosen solutions.
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders in an international, multidisciplinary, and Agile environment.
  • Review code and mentor junior engineers.
  • Share expertise to elevate the team, quality, and processes.
  • Act as an advisor and sparring partner for customers and stakeholders and inspire others to strive for quality.

What do we offer you?

This will keep you healthy:
