About Us:
At edclub, we are committed to revolutionizing the way K-12 students learn through engaging and interactive educational content. We create comprehensive, high-quality courses that inspire curiosity and facilitate deep learning. We're seeking a talented Designer to join our dynamic team to help bring educational content to life with creativity and purpose.

Job Description:
We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented UI/UX Designer to join our team. In this role, you will design educational materials that enhance learning experiences for students. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of user experience principles and a passion for creating intuitive, visually appealing digital products. You will collaborate with project managers, developers, and content creators to produce visually engaging and interactive educational tools.

This role will be fully remote, as our headquarters are located in Rockville, Maryland, USA.

  4. Collaborate with the team to brainstorm creative ideas and solutions for presenting content in innovative ways.
  5. Create engaging animations and motion graphics to enhance student learning and understanding.
  6. Stay up-to-date with design trends, animation techniques, and educational tools to continuously improve content quality.

Qualifications:

  1. 3-5 years of proven experience in graphic and UI/UX design.
  2. Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Illustrator; experience with animation tools like After Effects, Blender, or similar.
  3. Strong portfolio showcasing a range of design and animation work.
  4. Understanding of visual storytelling, typography, and layout principles.
  5. Knowledge of user-centered design principles and how students of different age groups engage with content.
  6. Communicate effectively in English with team members.
  7. Collaborative attitude with a willingness to accept feedback and adapt designs accordingly.
  8. Ability to think creatively and bring innovative ideas to enhance student engagement.

The Position

The Senior Telecom Manager is responsible for managing the Telecom Infrastructure planning, delivery, and operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 TM (FWWC 2027) within Brazil. Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Concepção de projeto de perfuração;
  • Análise e cadastro de insumos;
  • Análise e elaboração de resumo de ocorrências dos poços de correlação;
  • Elaboração ou avaliação de estudo de geopressões, geomecânica e estimativa de fechamento;
  • Assentar sapatas atendendo às normas de segurança e ao escopo do projeto;
  • Classificar a criticidade de poço;
  • Disponibilização dos insumos para projetos especializados e estimativa de duração e custos;
  • Preenchimento dos dados básicos no sistema de projetos e no de orçamentação;
  • Solicitação e análise crítica de estudos de geologia e caracterização biológica do leito marinho;
  • Solicitação e análise crítica de diagrama de restrições para operações em poços offshore;
  • Solicitação e análise crítica de documento declaratório de formações com potencial de fluxo;
  • Solicitação de estrutura analítica de projetos (EAP);
  • Solicitação de estudos especializados de perfuração de poços (projetos de revestimento, cabeça de poço, fluidos, BHA, direcional, perfilagem, alargamento e testemunhagem);
  • Solicitação e análise crítica de riser analysis e WSOG;
  • Solicitação de estimativa de duração probabilística da intervenção;
  • Condução de reunião de pré-projeto, de GEP (Grupo de Empreendimento de Poço) de planejamento, GEP de execução e de planejamento integrado de poço;
  • Participação nas reuniões operacionais, de gestão de mudança de seus poços, de CCAPE e CCAPD dos poços por ele projetados e dos eventos de lições aprendidas;
  • Elaboração dos documentos resultantes do projeto de perfuração (dados básicos, resumo executivo de FEL, cronograma executivo de perfuração e book de projetos);
  • Elaboração de documentos para órgãos externos (parceria, ANP e demais órgãos);
  • Preencher o checklist de perfuração em sistema;
  • Suporte ao coordenador de GEP durante toda a execução e passagem de serviço do poço;
  • Participação nas reuniões do poço projetado (como análises de risco e gestão de mudança);
  • Elaboração de análise preliminar de riscos, conforme padrões e normas;
  • Avaliação de sondas quanto otimização a segurança operacional contemplando, mas não limitado aos seguintes itens (Capacidade de corte do BOP, disponibilidade de EDS’s, avaliação do sistema de compensação e de posicionamento dinâmico da unidade e dos obstáculos na locação);
  • Elaboração de gestões de mudança de projeto;
  • Suportar a elaboração do documento de passagem de serviço dos poços (Handover);
  • Suportar a elaboração das análises de envelope operacional e conjunto solidários de barreiras.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação: Curso de Nível Superior em Engenharia em instituição reconhecida pelo Ministério da Educação (MEC) ou outro órgão do governo federal destinado a esse fim, com registro no respectivo Conselho de Classe.
  • Experiência: Em projeto e/ou execução de perfuração de poços de petróleo offshore.
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos: Competência de Dados — tratamento, transferência, coleta, organização, agrupamento, noções de análise estatística, árvore de decisão; Pacote Office: Word, Excel, Power Point; Power BI: Noções, filtros, organização dos dados, pesquisa. Operação básica com dados; Noções de projeto de poço marítimo; Noções de construção de poço direcional, vertical e horizontal como operador e como projetista: premissas básicas de projetos, limitações e boas práticas em projetos e execução; Noções de equipamentos de sondas de perfuração; Noções de conceitos básicos de perfuração direcional; Conhecimento de ferramentas direcionais: motores de fundo, rotary steerable e turbinas de perfuração (seleção, limites operacionais, vantagens e desvantagens e operação); Noções de ferramentas de mapeamento de poço: MWD, GWD, Gyro; Noções de ferramentas de perfilagem: LWD e ferramentas a cabo. Limites e operação (poço aberto e poço revestido); Influência do direcional nas descidas a cabo por gravidade; Noções de projeto de BHA: tubulares, alargadores, escareadores, percussores de perfuração; Noções de operação e projeto utilizando sistemas de alargamento (alargadores, ferramentas de eliminação de offset broca x alargador em manobra única, estabilização no poço alargado etc.); Noções de simulação: torque e drag, hidráulica de poço e desgaste de revestimento; Noções de brocas de perfuração: seleção e cálculo de hidráulica; Noções de hidráulica de poço: correlação entre limpeza de poço e geometria de trajetória; Noções de segurança de poço e análise anticolisão entre poços; Noções de geologia e geodésia; Noções de orçamentação de poços; Noções de operação e projeto de testemunhagem; Noções de operações e projeto de canhoneio; Noções de operações e projeto de MPD; Noções básicas dos tipos de completação (contenção de areia, completações simples e inteligentes, etc.); Noções básicas sobre cimentação, recimentação e correção da cimentação; Aplicação do canhoneio nos diferentes tipos de completação (cargas e densidades); Noções básicas de workover e de abandono; Noções básicas de caracterização de reservatório (geologia, geofísica e avaliação de reservatórios); Idiomas: Português (Brasil) - escrita e oral – nível fluente; Inglês técnico - escrita e oral - nível intermediário; Possuir noções básicas de construção de poços marítimos e dos equipamentos e sistemas de unidades de perfuração marítima; Desejáveis noções básicas em brocas, perfuração direcional, MPD, integridade de poços, estabilidade geomecânica de poços, fundações de poços, fluidos de perfuração, cimentação e equipamentos que compõem a estrutura de poços (cabeça de poço, revestimentos etc).

    Req#: 19863

    Local Unit & Position Description

    • Lead the on the ground, customer facing activities within LATAM, become that go to person for our clients.

    • Minimum Bachelors degree in engineering or business
    • Be the tenacious hunter.
    • Extrovert, happy to present to both small client groups but also to large audiences.

    • Have worked in a multi-cultural commercial environment.

    • Solution oriented and highly proactive.
    • Collaborative, both within immediate team and the wider business.
    • Excellent communication skills and ability to inspire people, building strong relationships.

    Preferable;

    • Experience in Renewables and/or offshore energy industries within the LATAM market.

    • Fluent in Spanish, both spoken and written.

    Company & Business Area Description

    DNV is the independent expert in assurance and risk management, operating in more than 100 countries. Through our broad experience and deep expertise we advance safety and sustainable performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions.

    We are a world-leading provider of digital solutions and software applications with focus on the energy, maritime and healthcare markets. Our solutions are used worldwide to manage risk and performance for wind turbines, electric grids, pipelines, processing plants, offshore structures, ships, and more. Supported by our domain knowledge and Veracity assurance platform, we enable companies to digitize and manage business critical activities in a sustainable, cost-efficient, safe and secure way.

    Product Line Renewables & Ocean Structures builds and distributes engineering software. Our mission is to “empower the world’s professionals to accelerate the energy transition, and sustainable use of the ocean”, and we aim “to be the most trusted engineering and digitalization partner, bringing value through our customer experience focus”. Our portfolio of software products includes a combination of successful industry favorites like Sesam, Bladed, and Nauticus Machinery, and new products aiming for hypergrowth WindFarmer and SolarFarmer.

    Our Product Line is part of the DNV – Digital Solutions business area, built up of functional teams across a collaborative organization structure. The Renewables & Ocean Structures product line includes a product center where software is developed, a product management team, sales regions and a marketing and communications team.

    This Senior Business Development role will report to the Head of Business Development, Americas Region as part of the commercial management team.

    The Senior Business Development Manager will have responsibility for leading DNV’s client facing strategy within the LATAM market, with the key focus on Brazil, to roll out a multi-year roadmap for the expansion of our market footprint within country.

    The key focus of this role is to develop DNV Digital Solutions penetration and market position within the LATAM market, the primary focus of which will be offshore wind. The Senior Business Development Manager will lead by example and build strong relationships, both internally with the wider regional commercial team, along with global functions, including the Product Line & Product Center, MarCom, Legal and Finance as well as interaction with clients at a senior, decision-maker level.

Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

You'll own the delivery lifecycle end-to-end—from architecture and design to production reliability, technical mentorship, and stakeholder alignment. We’re looking for someone who can turn complex requirements into secure, scalable, high‑quality software—and help the team grow in the process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own architecture and design: create system diagrams, define functional and non‑functional requirements (such as scalability, reliability, security and cost), and set integration standards.
  • Build and deliver using our technology stack with focus on quality, performance, and observability.
  • Lead initiatives: break down roadmaps, manage small to medium‑sized projects, remove blockers, and ensure on‑time delivery.
  • Plan and prioritize: create execution plans, estimate effort, manage risks, and clearly communicate progress to stakeholders.
  • Drive engineering excellence: enforce automated testing (unit, integration, e2e), deep code reviews, branch and release standards, and code quality.
  • Document for scale: maintain architecture documents, ADRs, operational guides, and runbooks, ensuring traceability and clarity within agile processes and tools.
  • Client interaction: attend remote and in‑person meetings, capture requirements, discuss trade‑offs, and present solutions clearly.
  • Mentor others: guide mid‑level and junior developers, share best practices, lead tech talks, and promote a learning culture.
  • Partner management: coordinate third parties, validate deliverables, and ensure alignment with project goals.
  • Ensure production quality: validate system integrations, instrument logs, metrics, and tracing, define basic SLOs, and participate in post‑mortems.
  • Continuous learning: explore new technologies, identify process improvements, and propose architectural enhancements.
  • Administrative support: handle operational requests and be available for national or international travel when required.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field.
  • Experience: 7+ years of professional experience, including technical leadership on complex projects.
  • Stack: Backend (Java, Python and .Net Core), Frontend (Angular), Node.js, SQL, strong background in REST API development, microservices and event‑driven architectures.
  • Cloud: Hands‑on experience with AWS or Azure, IAM (Identity and Access Management), storage, managed services and observability.
  • Quality & DevOps: Test automation, Git, Gitflow, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, semantic versioning and promotion across environments.
  • Security & Reliability: Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, secret management, least privilege, basic hardening, and observability (logs, metrics, tracing).
  • Language: Advanced English (written and spoken, client‑facing).
  • Profile: Proactive, system thinker, fluent with modern frameworks and best practices in development, testing, and cloud operations.

Nice To Have

  • Postgraduate or Master’s degree.
  • Spanish proficiency.
  • IaC (Terraform) and platform engineering principles.
  • Multi‑cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cost/performance optimization.
  • Exposure to performance tuning, caching, messaging/queue systems (e.g., Kafka), and feature flag management.

MonetizeMore is a global leader in ad revenue optimization. Our publisher partners run high-traffic websites across the world and expect top-tier solutions. For more than 14 years, we’ve built a reputation in ad tech—earning prestigious Google certifications and multiple fastest-growing company awards. With 100+ team members across the globe, we’re now looking for our next Publisher Partner – AMERICAS.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Be the MonetizeMore voice in the Americas—start smart conversations with enterprise publishers and spark interest fast.
  • Spot the right publishers, get yourself in the room, and turn first interactions into real prospects.
  • Dig into real problems (not surface-level pain) and translate them into “here’s why MonetizeMore makes sense now.”

  • Loves numbers and naturally thinks in data, insights, and measurable impact.

  • Has experience with ad-monetized publishers—a strong advantage, but not a blocker if the rest of your game is strong.
  • Can translate multiple, complex product propositions into clear business value that clicks with customers.
  • Moves fast to solve real publisher pain and keep deals progressing toward the close.
  • Treats the sales process as a competitive advantage—qualification, documentation, reporting, and next steps—because structure wins deals.
  • We sell a world-class ad optimization solution to some of the largest websites on the planet, solving real publisher challenges and helping them hit ambitious revenue goals.
  • We want someone who thrives leading enterprise sales with full autonomy and is confident closing high-ticket deals. Existing ad-tech relationships and connections with major ad-monetized publishers are a significant plus, and experience selling inventory to DV360 advertisers is highly advantageous.
  • English, Portuguese, and Spanish fluency is required.

Benefits & Perks

  • Work from anywhere in the world — we’re fully remote and always have been.
  • Own your schedule and structure your day around performance, not hours.
  • Competitive compensation package aligned with impact.

If you believe you’re the right fit for the MonetizeMore revenue team, fill out the application and tell us exactly what makes you stand out. We hire people, not robots—so don’t hold back on showing some personality.

Fundada em 20 de agosto de 1972, a Unimed do Estado do Rio de Janeiro – Federação Estadual das Cooperativas Médicas (Unimed Ferj) atua há 52 anos como representante estatutária de todas as Unimeds do estado. Ao longo de sua trajetória, a Unimed Ferj tem desempenhado um papel fundamental na promoção da conformidade regulatória e na implementação das melhores práticas de gestão entre as cooperativas do sistema Unimed no Rio de Janeiro.

Com uma governança corporativa voltada para a sustentabilidade e uma cultura organizacional focada em pessoas, a Unimed Ferj é uma referência no Sistema Unimed fluminense, que gera aproximadamente 16 mil empregos diretos e conta com uma ampla rede credenciada. Esses fatores contribuem para que o Sistema Unimed seja reconhecido como referência em Saúde Suplementar no Brasil.

Na função de Operadora de plano de saúde, a Unimed Ferj se dedica a oferecer um atendimento de excelência a mais de 470 mil clientes, por meio de uma ampla rede de médicos cooperados, unidades próprias e serviços credenciados.

Desde abril de 2024, a Unimed Ferj assumiu a gestão, o dimensionamento estrutural e o direcionamento assistencial do Hospital Unimed e dos Prontos Atendimentos Unimed na cidade do Rio de Janeiro. Nas unidades próprias, são mais de 2.400 profissionais comprometidos e dedicados a oferecer um cuidado humanizado e de excelência aos nossos pacientes.

Buscamos pessoas que valorizam as relações humanas e abraçam novas oportunidades. Na Rede Própria da Unimed Ferj, promovemos a diversidade, respeitamos diferentes ideias e perspectivas, e vivemos os princípios do cooperativismo, sempre com foco na excelência do cuidado.

Nossa cultura, O Jeito Agi

Viver pelo cliente
Nosso principal ativo são os clientes. A empresa só existe se conseguir resolver suas dores, entregando produtos e experiências melhores que alternativas disponíveis no mercado.

Agir como empreendedor
Quantas empresas você conhece que cobram espírito de dono do time? Muitas, né? Mas quantas delas possibilitam que as pessoas sejam de fato donas? No Agibank é assim, então aqui você age como dono porque já é dono ou porque sonha em ser o próximo.

Crescer na jornada
Nossa cultura é forte. Então, só faz sentido empreender aqui caso você se identifique muito com ela. Se você é uma pessoa fanática por resultado, tem pavor de zona de conforto, vive em eterna busca por conhecimento, prefere as coisas ditas direto ao ponto e quer estar rodeada de pessoas que também são assim, você vai curtir muito sua jornada aqui.

Seus desafios para crescer na jornada

  • Dominar o portfólio de produtos do Agibank.
  • Prospectar novos clientes através de ações externas, telemarketing ativo, atendimento via mídias sociais, indicações, parcerias, conversão de oportunidades, conversão de leads gerados e atendimento presencial em loja.

O que você precisa para se tornar um Agilizado?

Requisitos

  • Conhecimento básico do pacote Office

Diferenciais

Benefícios e facilidades

Programa Tô de dono
O Tô de Dono é mais do que um programa de incentivo a longo prazo – ele é o reconhecimento de quem vive diariamente a nossa cultura. A cada ano, o Programa tem novos participantes, colaboradores que se tornam donos do negócio e ganham com a valorização do Agibank sempre que a empresa cresce. Então, quem faz parte dessa história é quem mergulha de cabeça nos desafios para entregar grandes resultados. É assim que construímos, verdadeiramente, uma cultura de donos. Aqui, a fórmula é simples: você cresce. O Agibank cresce com você.

title: Procurement Coordinator
description:
Procurement Coordinator

Department: Finance

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Procurement Coordinator for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 will support the implementation of the FIFA27 Procurement Policy, ensuring organization-wide compliance through ongoing employee training and adherence checks. You will be responsible for the creation of Purchase Orders (POs) in SAP as well as other administrative matters. You will support project leaders with RFI/RFP processes. This role drives inter-departmental alignment and manages the FIFA27 SAP cost contract database to deliver cost efficiency, compliant, simple and transparent solutions across FIFA procurement landscape.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Implement the FIFA27 Procurement Policy and procedures across the organization. Act as gatekeeper of the process at the relevant stages.
  • Train employees on an on-going basis to ensure adherence to FIFA27 Procurement Policy.
  • Responsible for the SAP cost contract database, including entering and maintaining contract data and creation of Purchase Orders (POs).
  • Manage (solve or forward) queries raised to the FIFA27 Procurement team mailbox.
  • Support project leaders in all matters regarding procurement including tasks such as setting up RFIs and RFPs.
  • Create spend reports for management as requested.
  • Conduct administrative activities of the procurement team.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Terciary education in Business Administration, Procurement and/or extensive experience in indirect procurement.
  • Minimum 1 year experience in a similar role.
  • Good SAP MM knowledge is an asset.
  • Knowledge of DocuSign is an asset.
  • Knowledge of ServiceNow is an asset

a nossa história começou há 27 anos, em um pequeno estande na Babilônia Feira Hype, onde dois amigos, Kátia Barros e Marcelo Bastos, compartilhavam suas criações e espalhavam boas energias. o que nasceu no coração do Rio logo conquistou a cena local, ganhou o Brasil e se transformou no que somos hoje.

em 2019, cruzamos fronteiras e levamos o estilo de vida da FARM Rio para o mundo. de Nova York a Los Angeles, de Paris a Londres, nossas cores, estampas e essência seguem inspirando pessoas pelos quatro cantos do planeta. e seguimos sonhando, criando e levando o Brasil no coração para cada lugar que nos recebe.

Especialista de Planejamento e Orçamento de Obras

Um aeroporto com a alma carioca! O RIOgaleão é o maior equipamento urbano do Rio de Janeiro, com grande importância para a economia do estado. Ao longo de 10 anos de operação, recebemos mais de 100 milhões de passageiros, fomos o aeroporto Olímpico, vimos a cura da Covid chegar pelo nosso Terminal de Cargas e somos a porta de entrada para os principais eventos da cidade.

Nosso Jeito RIOgaleão de Ser abraça a diversidade, por isso, nossos processos seletivos são abertos à todos, afinal trabalhamos todos os dias para a verdadeira conexão.

Se você se identifica com esses valores e deseja fazer parte de uma equipe dinâmica e que adora desafios, temos uma oportunidade como Especialista de Planejamento e Orçamento de Obras . Neste desafio, você atuará como referência técnica na elaboração, análise e controle de orçamentos e cronogramas de projetos de investimento (CAPEX) do aeroporto, garantindo robustez nas estimativas de custo, aderência às premissas de projeto, previsibilidade de riscos e clareza na comunicação para tomada de decisão executiva.

Responsabilidades

  • Elaborar orçamentos detalhados de obras e serviços de engenharia, com base em cadernos de referência e demais bases oficiais;

  • Avaliar e validar premissas de orçamentação e planejamento;
  • Analisar soluções técnicas sob a ótica de custo, prazo e risco;
  • Apoiar decisões de alternativas técnicas e construtivas.
  • Estruturar e acompanhar o faseamento físico-financeiro dos projetos;
  • Identificar, analisar e quantificar riscos de custo e prazo, prevendo possíveis desvios e contingências;
  • Preparar análises críticas de variações (desvios) de orçamento e cronograma ao longo do ciclo do projeto;
  • Desenvolver apresentações executivas para defesa de desvios e impactos financeiros;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com escritório externo de projetos/orçamentos, garantindo alinhamento técnico e metodológico, qualidade das entregas e cumprimento de prazos, com postura de liderança técnica;
  • Apoiar processos de governança de CAPEX, auditorias técnicas e revisões internas;
  • Conhecimento em Planejamento físico-financeiro e gestão de riscos de custos e prazo.

Habilidades e qualificações necessárias

  • Formação em Engenharia Civil ou Engenharia de Produção;
  • Experiência comprovada em Orçamentos de obras de infraestrutura e edificações e análise de CAPEX para empreendimentos complexos;
  • Excel Avançado: Modelagem de planilhas orçamentárias, análise de cenários, curvas físicas e financeiras, uso de funções avançadas e tabela dinâmica;
  • Inglês Avançado;

  • Utilização de Ferramenta de Organização;
  • Pacote Office Avançado;
  • Boa comunicação, tanto para escrita quanto para fala;
  • Visão analítica;
  • Possuir as Atitudes GATE do Integrante RIOgaleão: Garra e Determinação, Autodesenvolvimento, Trabalho em Equipe e Espírito de Dono.

Você sai na frente se

title: Evaluation Scenario Writer - AI Agent Testing Specialist
description:
What We Do

The Mindrift platform, launched and powered by Toloka, connects domain experts with cutting‑edge AI projects from innovative tech clients. Our mission is to unlock the potential of GenAI by tapping into real‑world expertise from across the globe.

About The Role

We’re looking for someone who can design realistic and structured evaluation scenarios for LLM‑based agents. You’ll create test cases that simulate human‑performed tasks and define gold‑standard behavior to compare agent actions against. You’ll work to ensure each scenario is clearly defined, well‑scored, and easy to execute and reuse. You’ll need a sharp analytical mindset, attention to detail, and an interest in how AI agents make decisions.

Although every project is unique, you might typically:

  • Design structured test scenarios based on real‑world tasks
  • Define the golden path and acceptable agent behavior
  • Annotate task steps, expected outputs, and edge cases
  • Work with devs to test your scenarios and improve clarity
  • Review agent outputs and adapt tests accordingly

How To Get Started

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you’ll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s and/or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / NLP, Information Systems or other related fields
  • Background in QA, software testing, data analysis, or NLP annotation
  • Good understanding of test design principles (e.g., reproducibility, coverage, edge cases)
  • Strong written communication skills in English
  • Comfortable with structured formats like JSON/YAML for scenario description
  • Can define expected agent behaviors (gold paths) and scoring logic
  • Basic experience with Python and JS
  • Curious and open to working with AI‑generated content, agent logs, and prompt‑based behavior
  • Ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines
  • Freelance role is fully remote; you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available, and enthusiasm to take on a challenge

Nice to Have

  • Experience in writing manual or automated test cases
  • Familiarity with LLM capabilities and typical failure modes
  • Understanding of scoring metrics (precision, recall, coverage, reward functions)

Benefits

Contribute on your own schedule, from anywhere in the world. This opportunity allows you to:

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates up to $17/hour depending on experience and project needs
  • Take part in a flexible, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments
  • Participate in an advanced AI project and gain valuable experience to enhance your portfolio
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta we create owners and make private markets liquid.

We live in a world where some people live on the equity stack and enjoy exponential wealth growth and preferential tax treatment; others live on the debt stack and may work their entire lives for a company and retire only with the cash they’ve managed to save from their paychecks. Our contribution to solving the wealth inequality problem is moving people from the debt stack (payroll) to the equity stack. By making it as easy to issue equity to employees as it is to put them on payroll, we can create more owners.

At Carta, we are helpful, transparent, fair, and kind. We are relentless executors, unconventional thinkers, and masters of our craft.

title: AI Agent Evaluation Analyst (Freelance)
description:
This opportunity is only for candidates currently residing in the specified country. Your location may affect eligibility and rates. Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective human intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform, launched and powered by Toloka, connects domain experts with cutting‑edge AI projects from innovative tech clients. Our mission is to unlock the potential of GenAI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for curious and intellectually proactive contributors, the kind of person who double‑checks assumptions and plays devil’s advocate. Are you comfortable with ambiguity and complexity? Does an async, remote, flexible opportunity sound exciting? Would you like to learn how modern AI systems are tested and evaluated?

Type of role

This is a flexible, project-based opportunity well‑suited for:

  • Analysts, researchers, or consultants with strong critical‑thinking skills
  • Students (senior undergrads / grad students) looking for an intellectually interesting gig
  • People open to a part‑time and non‑permanent opportunity

About the project

We’re on the hunt for QAs for autonomous AI agents for a new project focused on validating and improving complex task structures, policy logic, and agent evaluation frameworks. Throughout the project, you’ll have to balance quality assurance, research, and logical problem‑solving. This project opportunity is ideal for people who enjoy looking at systems holistically and thinking through scenarios, implications, and edge cases. You do not need a coding background, but you must be curious, intellectually rigorous, and capable of evaluating the soundness and consistency of complex setups.

What you’ll be doing

  • Reviewing evaluation tasks and scenarios for logic, completeness, and realism
  • Identifying inconsistencies, missing assumptions, or unclear decision points
  • Helping define clear expected behaviours (gold standards) for AI agents
  • Annotating cause‑effect relationships, reasoning paths, and plausible alternatives
  • Thinking through complex systems and policies as a human would to ensure agents are tested properly
  • Working closely with QA, writers, or developers to suggest refinements or edge case coverage

How to get started

Apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to a project aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. Shape the future of AI while building tools that benefit everyone.

Requirements

  • Excellent analytical thinking: can reason about complex systems, scenarios, and logical implications
  • Strong attention to detail: can spot contradictions, ambiguities, and vague requirements
  • Familiarity with structured data formats: can read, not necessarily write JSON/YAML
  • Ability to assess scenarios holistically: what’s missing, what’s unrealistic, what might break?
  • Good communication and clear writing (in English) to document your findings.

We also value applicants who have

  • Experience with policy evaluation, logic puzzles, case studies, or structured scenario design
  • Background in consulting, academia, olympiads (e.g. logic/math/informatics), or research
  • Exposure to LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI‑generated content
  • Familiarity with QA or test‑case thinking (edge cases, failure modes, “what could go wrong”)
  • Some understanding of how scoring or evaluation works in agent testing (precision, coverage, etc.)

Benefits

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $17/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs
  • Take part in a flexible, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments
  • Participate in an advanced AI project and gain valuable experience to enhance your portfolio
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise

Seniority level

Employment type

  • Part‑time

Job function

Industries

  • IT Services and IT Consulting

Preferred Qualifications

title: Art Lead - NFL Universe Football
description:
Art Lead - NFL Universe Football

Join to apply for the Art Lead - NFL Universe Football role at Voldex.

Voldex is a leading gaming company focused on Roblox, the most exciting ecosystem in gaming today. We are home to several of Roblox’s top games, including Brookhaven, Driving Empire, and NFL Universe Football. With over 145 million monthly active players across our games, we are the #1 Roblox developer by audience size. Founded in 2015, we have since grown to 75+ full‑time remote team members across the globe.

Our top games include:

  • Brookhaven, #1 Roleplay game on Roblox and the most popular game on the Roblox platform
  • Driving Empire, the #1 driving game on Roblox where we’ve brought real cars into the game in partnership with automakers
  • NFL Universe Football, the #1 American football game and top grossing sports game on Roblox

Responsibilities

  • Contribute a consistent allocation of time to building out 3D art assets for the game
  • Address artistic challenges, manage art‑team workloads, and ensure art assets are delivered on time, efficiently, and within the technical performance budget
  • Lead, manage, and mentor a small team of artists, providing clear direction, constructive feedback, and fostering a positive, creative work environment
  • Lead game’s style and art direction
  • Supervise both 2D, 3D, and render artists
  • Develop and maintain art‑production pipelines, processes, and documentation to ensure efficient asset creation and implementation
  • Review and provide feedback on the team’s work, ensuring assets meet quality standards and align with the artistic vision and technical requirements of the project

Requirements

  • A deep understanding of asset performance metrics and methodologies on the Roblox platform
  • High proficiency in Roblox Studio and substantial experience on the Roblox platform
  • 1‑3 years of experience working in a professional studio environment or a mixture of Roblox creator experience that demonstrates equivalent expertise and leadership
  • Highly organized and process oriented, needs to be able to think in scale and systems to help level up the Art team

Nice to Have

  • Experience creating art assets under performance constraints while maintaining a clear, visually appealing style
  • Experience collaborating with game designers and product teams to understand art request details and flag risks or needs for additional information
  • Proven ability to own a game’s art direction and mentor a team of artists toward a consistent execution of that style or direction
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage and mentor a diverse team of artists
  • Familiarity with project management tools such as Monday.com, Asana, JIRA, or similar applications
  • Familiar with or a fan of American Football

Tech Stack

  • Roblox Studio
  • Photoshop / GIMP / Substance Painter
  • Maya
  • Blender

Location

  • Remote
  • Travel - 2 to 3x / year (onboarding, RDC + possible team meet‑ups)
  • Time Zone – must be willing to work EST/PST hours
  • Ideal Hiring Regions: Canada, UK, LATAM

Voldex is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation – above‑market salary + profit sharing + stock options
  • Retirement benefits – company contribution to your retirement plan (401k, RRSP, Pension), in Canada, UK and USA!
  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits – depending on the country, there may be additional benefits (Life, ADD, etc…) such as Canada, UK and USA.
  • Flexible PTO – vacations + Federal / Bank Holidays
  • Remote First – we have always been remote and will remain that way including work from home/anywhere
  • In‑person get‑togethers, virtual company‑wide game events, Robux allowances, and so much more!
  • Professional Development – reimburse the costs of courses, materials, and anything to help further your training and growth
  • Work with awesome people and impact millions of daily players

title: OPERADOR (A) PERTENCER PCD
description:
Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações.

Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.

Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo(B3) e Nova Iorque(NYSE).

Programa Pertencer – Gerdau

A Gerdau está sempre em busca de formas de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro. Por isso, em parceria com a Firjan e com certificação do SENAI, desenvolvemos o Programa Pertencer , uma iniciativa de capacitação profissional voltada exclusivamente para mulheres e pessoas com deficiência.

Para nós, “Pertencer” significa mais do que estar em um lugar onde a diversidade é respeitada, é também perceber que ela é, de fato, valorizada.

Objetivo do programa

O objetivo do programa é capacitar mulheres e pessoas com deficiência interessadas em ingressar no ambiente industrial da empresa . Essa é uma porta de entrada para a companhia e visa habilitar novos profissionais para atuar na indústria, não sendo exigida experiência prévia .

Público-alvo:

  • Pessoas com deficiência;
  • A partir de 18 anos;
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Preferencialmente residentes da Zona Oeste do RJ, Itaguaí ou Seropédica , nas proximidades da Usina Cosigua .

Local:

Usina Cosigua – Rio de Janeiro/RJ

✨ O que buscamos:

  • Vontade de aprender e se desenvolver;
  • Senso de resolução de problemas;
  • Habilidades de comunicação;
  • Proatividade, espírito colaborativo e autonomia.

O que oferecemos:

  • Assistência médica SULAMERICA ou UNIMED Nacional (sem carência);
  • Pronto atendimento virtual Hospital Albert Einstein;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Refeição na empresa;
  • Vale alimentação;
  • Transporte fretado;
  • Benefício farmácia, fisioterapia e dentista;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Estacionamento no local;
  • Programa +Cuidado (apoio psicológico e social).

Etapas do processo seletivo:

  • Triagem dos requisitos;
  • Entrevista inicial;
  • Dinâmica de grupo;
  • Entrevista com a Área de Pessoas e líder da área operacional;
  • Visita à área;
  • Exames admissionais;
  • Entrega da documentação;
  • Admissão.

DIVERSIDADE É O QUE NOS MOVE.

Para nós, a diversidade e a inclusão são valores fundamentais . Entendemos que pessoas, independentemente da idade, características físicas ou individuais, devem se sentir seguras e representar na Gerdau o extrato real da sociedade.

Seguiremos valorizando a diversidade e promovendo a inclusão , buscando de forma intencional a participação de mulheres e pessoas com deficiência para desenvolver novos talentos e aumentar a equidade na Gerdau.

Na Gerdau, diversidade e inclusão são compromissos reais . Todas as pessoas qualificadas serão consideradas para as vagas, sem distinção de gênero, idade, raça, religião, orientação sexual, nacionalidade ou deficiência .

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Venha fazer parte da PRIO

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space, o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões.

Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Respiramos e somos referência no varejo, lideramos pelo exemplo, inspiramos e desenvolvemos o potencial das nossas pessoas para fazerem sempre mais e melhor pelo nosso cliente! Há mais de 40 anos, temos ao nosso lado os principais varejistas do Brasil, e um time igualmente capacitado para fazê-los chegar ainda mais longe! Com autonomia e flexibilidade, nossas pessoas buscam diariamente construir soluções de tecnologia para gestão que impactem os negócios pelo Brasil e América Latina. Se você é assim como a gente e tem o desejo genuíno de ajudar negócios por meio de uma Tecnologia feita por e para pessoas, então aqui é a sua próxima parada!

Quer fazer parte do nosso time de Retail como Pessoa Executiva de Vendas Sr ?

Como será o seu dia a dia #soulinx:

  • Identificar novas oportunidades de negócio, realizando prospecção ativa porta a porta.
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias comerciais para aumentar a participação de mercado e impulsionar as vendas no setor varejista.
  • Analisar dados de vendas e desempenho do mercado, utilizando insights para ajustar estratégias e atingir metas.
  • Elaborar propostas no CRM, desde a construção do escopo até as negociações e fechamento.
  • Manter todos os dados atualizados no CRM, como registros de apresentações comerciais e follow-ups.
  • Monitorar o desempenho do pipe, identificando oportunidades de crescimento e riscos potenciais, propondo soluções como upsell e melhorias de produto.
  • Participar de eventos e palestras para fomentar vendas dos nossos produtos.

Requisitos para você mover o varejo junto com a gente:

  • Experiência na área comercial em empresa de tecnologia.
  • Capacidade de conduzir negociações complexas e fechar negócios.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e em equipe, com foco em resultados.
  • Experiência em construir e manter relacionamentos duradouros com clientes-chave e stakeholders.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de CRM e análise de dados.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de apresentar ideias de forma clara e persuasiva.
  • Resiliência emocional para atingir metas e resolver problemas.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo híbrido.
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias aplicadas ao varejo.

Como você pode contar com a gente?

description:
Analista de Documentação - Rio de Janeiro/RJ

Join to apply for the Analista de Documentação - Rio de Janeiro/RJ role at Capco.

Requisitos Mandatórios

  • 3 (três) anos de experiência comprovada atuando na função;
  • Experiência em utilização de Sistemas de Gestão Eletrônica de Documentos (GEDs);
  • Experiência em estruturação e organização de arquivos físicos e eletrônicos;
  • Experiência com SIGEM;
  • Domínio do Pacote MS-Office;
  • Domínio do Acrobat Profissional.

Escolaridade

Atribuições

  • Arquivamento de documentação (conforme normas, sistemas internos e orientações do TCU) regularmente em mídias físicas e digitais;

  • Participar de reuniões junto à EPCIsta;
  • Controle de toda a documentação recebida e elaboração de relatórios específicos;
  • Atuar proativamente para que todos os requisitos dos anexos contratuais sejam atendidos.

Sobre a Capco

Na Capco promovemos uma cultura inclusiva. Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas expressões.

Pensamos, em conjunto, sempre em ações diversas de inclusão e de responsabilidade social através de comitês internos geridos pela nossa comunidade interna, como os grupos de Mulheres, Pessoas Com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras, LGBTQIAPN+, Parentalidade, Gerações, entre outros.

Nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas para todos(as)!!!

description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission‑critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.

The Role

Join our team of passionate technology professionals dedicated to providing hands‑on support and maintaining systems for a wide range of end users, including executive support. As a Deskside Support Specialist , you’re more than a problem solver – you’re a true technology hero.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the go‑to expert for testing and troubleshooting, identifying and resolving issues related to software upgrades, system imaging, and hardware deployments.
  • Provide support for hardware and software issues across multiple device types, both on‑site and remotely.
  • Ensure excellent customer service by meeting SLA and XLA targets.
  • Collaborate with internal Kyndryl teams and strategic partners such as Microsoft.
  • Identify opportunities for modernization and automation, presenting innovative ideas to enhance the end‑user experience and reduce costs.
  • Support projects involving the deployment of cutting‑edge technologies, ensuring a seamless experience for users.

Your future at Kyndryl

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands‑on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer‑focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Experience providing IT support.
  • Experience in Audiovisual.
  • Experience working in a customer‑facing environment.
  • Strong communication skills (email, phone, and in‑person).
  • On‑site support capability.
  • Fluent in Portuguese.

Preferred Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related technical field.

Knowledge of popular operating systems and enterprise applications.

Workplace

Rio de Janeiro
São Paulo
Florianópolis
Recife

Being You

Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single‑handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way.

What You Can Expect

With state‑of‑the‑art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well‑being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company‑wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non‑profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked “How Did You Hear About Us” during the application process, select “Employee Referral” and enter your contact’s Kyndryl email address.

Buscamos pessoas extremamente organizadas, além de habilidades técnicas e comerciais a fim de desenvolver um trabalho de excelência junto a nossos clientes.

description:
Social Investment Senior Advisor

Join to apply for the Social Investment Senior Advisor role at Shell.

What’s The Role

You will be a key player in our Societal Impact and Energy Transition program team in Shell Brasil’s Corporate Relations team. One of our objectives is to create a positive presence and legacy in the communities and countries in which we operate and to be a trusted and responsible neighbour. We do this by engaging with our communities, identifying and mitigating the social impacts of our operations, and delivering benefits through social investment.

You will be working closely with the Societal Impact and Energy Transition Program Manager and business colleagues in the country, as well as the regional and global Social Performance Centre of Excellence in Shell.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Developing and implementing a robust social investment strategy for Shell in Brazil that is aligned with our business objectives in-country, Shell’s Group social investment strategy and requirements, and the social context of our communities
  • Identifying and designing meaningful social investment programmes in line with the strategy
  • Selecting and managing delivery partners to help us implement our social investment programmes
  • Driving implementation of the social investment programmes, with clear oversight and regular review of performance against goals and targets
  • Developing and executing monitoring, evaluation, and learning plans for our social investment programmes, jointly with our delivery partners
  • Undertaking social baseline and evaluation studies as needed to help inform and continuously improve social investment programmes
  • Developing and implementing impact‑led communication plans for internal and external stakeholders
  • Engaging leaders to create a shared vision and internal alignment on Shell Brazil social investment objectives and activities
  • Representing Shell externally and engaging with a broad range of stakeholders including communities, government, joint venture partners, civil society organisations, among others
  • Proactively identifying and managing risks to the social investment programmes, and identifying continuous improvement opportunities to ensure the programmes remain externally relevant, impactful, and efficient
  • Developing and coordinating the disaster response plans for supporting communities where needed
  • Ensuring compliance with Shell’s business principles, ethics, and compliance standards
  • Ensuring budget and activity planning and tracking progress, and compliance with Shell’s global reporting requirements for social investment spend and outcomes

What You Bring

  • Must have legal authorization to work in Brazil on a full‑time basis for anyone other than the current employer.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • 15+ years of experience with qualifications relevant to social development
  • Significant experience and proven track record in designing and delivering social development programmes, in particular related to STEM skills, enterprise development, and livelihood programmes
  • Experience working with corporates in designing and delivering social programmes with a good understanding of business processes and influencing senior business leaders
  • Extensive external network in the development sector to help create strong collaborations and partnerships
  • Experience managing external delivery partners
  • Experience in developing monitoring, evaluation, and learning frameworks; measuring and reporting impacts
  • Strategic and critical thinking skills to design and develop new programmes, and the ability to troubleshoot and solve problems
  • Strong communication (written and verbal), presentation, and facilitation skills; business fluency in English is a minimum requirement
  • Excellent collaboration, stakeholder influencing, and management skills across organizational boundaries and different levels of seniority, without direct authority
  • Ability to uphold high‑quality standards, anticipate and manage risks
  • Excellent project/programme management skills
  • Solid team leadership skills
  • Learner mindset – role model curiosity and reflection, and encourage people to learn from mistakes and successes
  • Maximise performance – integrate and collaborate across boundaries to maximise commercial value for the organisation as a whole

What We Offer

  • Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
  • Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
  • Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
  • Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
  • Achieve your balance in a values‑led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
  • Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.
  • Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance‑related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.
  • Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non‑birthing parents.
  • Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
  • Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams.
  • Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

Shell in Brazil

Shell is a global group of energy and petrochemical companies, employing 103,000 people and with operations in more than 70 countries. We use advanced technologies and take an innovative approach as we seek to help the world build a sustainable energy future.

Shell is a customer‑focused organisation, serving more than 1 million commercial and industrial customers, and around 33 million customers daily at more than 47,000 Shell‑branded retail service stations.

Our approach

Shell’s strategy is to deliver more value with less emissions as we work to become a net‑zero emissions business by 2050.

As we navigate the energy transition through the next decade, we will leverage our global footprint, the trust in our brand, and our innovation and technology capabilities to be the energy company that customers and countries choose to be their partner. We are positioning Shell to become the investment case and partner of choice through the energy transition.

Our values

At Shell, we share a set of core values – honesty, integrity and respect for people – which underpin all the work we do. The Shell General Business Principles, Code of Conduct and Ethics and Compliance Manual help everyone at Shell act in line with these values and comply with relevant laws and regulations.

description:
Static Mechanical Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

Full relocation to Saudi Arabia – permanent full-time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview: We are seeking a Plant Corrosion Engineer to join the Riyas Engineering Division (RNGLFD) which is part of the Riyas NGL Fractionation Dept (RNGLFD).

RNGLFD is responsible for two trains, each designed to process 255 MBOD (242.25 MBCD). Each train will include fractionation units, C3 & C4 treatment, C3 & C4 dehydration and propane refrigeration. The common facilities will include feed and product surge storage, chemicals storage and utilities including, but not limited to, steam and condensate recovery systems, utility water, plant, instrument air and nitrogen systems, machinery cooling water, drainage and flare systems. Some of the systems (e.g., steam headers, flare headers, product storage) have been pre-invested for the future train.

Your primary role will be to implement, support and continually improve RNGLFP inspection corrosion management programs and provide consolatory advice in materials, ensuring cost effective material selection and corrosion mitigation strategies, which will ensure mechanical integrity of the materials, applied on all plant assets including equipment and piping through their life cycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement corrosion management program and on-stream monitoring and Conduct risk-based inspection based on API-580 methodology.
  • Review and approve recommended solutions for coating failures and cathodic protection and participate in HAZOP review sessions and ensure that all issues are addressed.
  • Manage water treatment program and recommend solutions to overcome challenges and review design packages and validate materials selection based on current code and standards.
  • Validate corrosion controls corrosion controls, corrosion (CCD), corrosion loops and corrosion damage mechanisms frequently.
  • Assess FEED composition changes and approve recommended solution to assure assets integrity.
  • Develop scope and description of technology items, and lead field implementation.
  • Develop and transfer knowledge about use of coating, Cathodic protection (CP), corrosion inhibitors and other corrosion controls and best practices.
  • Extract data and draw conclusions from Corrosion Monitoring Technologies, and troubleshoot corrosion problems and address root causes.
  • Perform the regular review and update on the plants Integrity Operating Windows (IOW) and Corrosion loops drawings shall be updated by adding emerging damage mechanisms or removing damage mechanisms because of plant upgrades.
  • Adjust and modify inspection practices and programs shall be reflected based on such modifications and perform special studies in corrosion control. Evaluates data as to scope, impact and long-range cost effectiveness on existing and new projects.
  • Review operations and monitoring activities to identify needed system modifications or procedural changes associated with corrosion control with conduct corrosion mitigation and integrity review to optimize the inspection and corrosion programs and maintain assets integrity.

Qualification Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, preferably in mechanical engineer.
  • 15 years' experience processing in Oil/Gas Industry.
  • Demonstrate experience in material science and metrology, different NDT technology and their applications and knowledge in engineering aspect of welding.
  • Strong Knowledge of international standards and codes NACE, ASME, API and ASTM especially inspection and corrosion standards such as API-571, API-580, API-570 and API-510.
  • Valid NACE Specialist Certification or NACE Senior Corrosion Technologist or combination of NACE Corrosion Technologist, API-571 and NACE CP level II.

KEY EXPECTED ACHIEVEMENTS :

1) Definition of sourcing strategy and tactical management:

  • Contribute to sourcing strategy definition.
  • Develop expertise of the markets through portfolio segmentation & analysis of opportunities and threats in collaboration with the business entities and under guidance of the Category Manager: PSA (Purchasing Strategy Assessment), RMat wrap up ...
  • Ensure markets business model analysis and inflation monitoring.
  • Define and challenge short and midlong term needs of the business entities.
  • Evaluate/ anticipate risks (notably business continuity) and implement mitigation action plans if needed on its portfolio scope.
  • Realize and update on regular basis portfolio analysis (incl. spend, suppliers, internal partner risk, SWOT, action plan ...)
  • Define supplier panel definition & supplier segmentation in collaboration with Category Manager and the business entities.
  • Deploy, at the right level the defined sourcing strategy (corporate / regions or country)

(2) Evaluation & selection of new suppliers:

  • Prospectively evaluate new suppliers in accordance with the Purchasing category strategy
  • Realize Benchmark with other companies on the same scope of activities/ same markets.
  • Define negotiation strategy and objectives and lead negotiation process.
  • Make tenders and negotiate: Request For Information, Request For Quotation, Request For Price (RFI, RFQ, RFP).
  • Ensure relevance & accuracy RFI, RFQ, RFP documents and challenge internal partners if needed (Except RMAT)
  • Lead suppliers' evaluation & selection and select the most suitable suppliers in collaboration with the business entities.
  • Responsible for the realization of the homologation process of new sourcing/suppliers for RMAT

(3) Establish new contracts & amendments:

  • Lead negotiation and contracting with all internal& external stakeholders.
  • Negotiate and have contracts/amendments signed with suppliers at the right level (Group or local) in collaboration with the Business entities, and in alignment with Purchasing category sourcing strategy.
  • Ensure that the content of the contract is aligned with the results of the negotiation and that the right performance indicators are specified.
  • Ensure that the elements of the contract can be implemented and monitored.
  • Contribute to the deployment of the contract in the Michelin entities, with the Contract Manager Business lead.

(4) Animation of supplier relationship management to drive business performance.

  • Lead Supplier Relationship Management process as a KSM (Key Supplier Manager)
  • Animate introduction of innovative solutions in collaboration with suppliers and the business entities (IWS: Innovation with supplier)
  • Evaluate and steer the performance of the supplier (Business review, Supply review, SRM review, …) and implement a progress plan.
  • Guarantee the purchasing excellence of the interactions with the supplier (digitalization of invoices, data quality...)
  • Support claims (contractual disputes, non-conformities, problem of supply) with various stakeholders when needed.
  • Address CSR stakes /ambition on his/her portfolio.

(5) Is accountable for the quality of the purchasing & procurement data.

Your primary role is to support the Upstream Digital Center (UDC) network infrastructure and services.

Key Responsibilities

  • Operating and maintaining the UDC network infrastructure, including data center networks, user building networks, and DR site networks.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Communication Engineering, or Electrical Engineering from an accredited university.
  • 10+ years of experience in network engineering and architecture on carrier IP networks with hands‑on routing, switching, and load balancing experience in a cloud provider environment.
  • 7+ years of experience in IP networks (running Ethernet, OSPF, BGP, MPLS, Layer 2 Switching, VRFs, etc.).
  • 7+ years of experience troubleshooting and resolving complex routing and switching problems in an IP‑based carrier network.
  • Experience with Linux and excellent knowledge of core network services (DNS, SMTP, NTP, syslog, HTTP).
  • Experience with programming Python or shell scripting, especially as it relates to SDN.
  • Expert‑level knowledge in routing and switching protocols (BGP, OSPF, MPBGP, MPLS).
  • Strong knowledge of IPv6, multicast, QoS, IP fast rerouting, IPSec VPN, DMVPN, and VPLS.
  • Strong knowledge in network security and enterprise security, such as DDOS, firewall, IPS, malware detection, etc.
  • Experience in designing internet backbone networks including a solid understanding of best practices, scalability strategy, and managed security services.
  • Knowledge of SDN, NFV, and SD‑WAN.
  • Preferred certifications: Cisco or Juniper ‘E’ level, additional security and VoIP certifications, CCNP, CCIE, JNCIS, JNCIP, JNCIE.

  • Metrologia básica (instrumentos de medição e controle dimensional).
  • Conhecimento intermediário em programação CNC (ajustes em G-code, corretores de ferramenta, parâmetros de corte).

Comprometidos com a promoção da saúde e do bem-estar, nossas equipes trabalham diariamente para oferecer experiências inclusivas, sustentáveis e socialmente engajadas. Seja de forma presencial ou por canais digitais, desenvolvemos soluções e serviços inovadores que nos posicionam como a melhor escolha para nossos parceiros. Afinal, entregar saúde é o nosso propósito.

Acreditamos que enxergar é mais do que ver - é reconhecer as singularidades que tornam cada pessoa única. Por isso, reforçamos nosso compromisso com a Diversidade & Inclusão por meio do programa Diversidade em Cena.

Promovemos um ambiente acolhedor e respeitoso para todos, valorizando as diferenças de gênero, etnia, deficiências, orientação sexual (LGBTI+), crenças, religiões e outras individualidades.

Com infraestrutura moderna e eficiente, o Atacadão disponibiliza aos seus clientes uma variada gama de produtos, com cerca de 10 mil itens, nas categorias de laticínios, hortifrúti, bebidas, doces e biscoitos, higiene pessoal, limpeza, bazar, produtos da linha pet, automotivo, entre outros, além de serviços como padaria, açougue e frios e fatiados.
O Atacadão marca presença no ambiente digital por meio do seu e-commerce, com um próprio canal de vendas online mais direcionado a transformadores, comerciantes e empreendedores de pequenas, médias e grandes empresas, pela possibilidade de adquirir volumes maiores de itens, parcerias com aplicativos de entrega que atendem ao consumidor final, e também o Meu Atacadão, aplicativo que permite que os clientes encontrem ofertas diferenciadas enquanto fazem suas compras nas lojas físicas.
Tem como pilares de sustentabilidade o combate à fome e às desigualdades, a diversidade e inclusão e a proteção ao planeta & biodiversidade.

Basic Function

Howard University seeks a dynamic and skilled College Research Administration Manager to oversee research administration activities within assigned colleges. This hybrid reporting role is pivotal to advancing the university’s R1 research mission by ensuring compliance, enhancing research productivity, and maintaining efficient workflows. The manager will handle pre‑ and post‑award responsibilities, working collaboratively with the Office of Research, college leadership, Principal Investigators (PIs), and other stakeholders.

Nature And Scope

Serve as the primary POC for all assigned departments within the college for pre‑award and post‑award support. This position has a primary reporting line to the Office of Research for strategic oversight, training, and compliance. A dotted‑line reporting relationship with the Associate Dean for Research allows for alignment with the day‑to‑day priorities of the assigned college. The incumbent will serve as a bridge between central oversight and college‑specific needs, ensuring the success of research activities across the institution. External contacts include representatives from the federal government, other colleges and universities, professional associations, consultants, vendors, and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

Pre‑Award Management

  • Guide PIs in preparing and submitting grant proposals, including budgets, narratives, and compliance documentation.
  • Serve as the primary liaison for grant submissions to central research offices and funding agencies.
  • Review and approve proposals for adherence to university, federal, and sponsor guidelines.

Post‑Award Management

  • Oversee grant account setups, cost distributions, and personnel appointments on awarded projects.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, local, and university policies regarding allowable costs, effort reporting, and project amendments.
  • Monitor project budgets and expenditures, providing timely financial reports and projections.

Compliance and Reporting

  • Facilitate the preparation and submission of internal and external reports, including progress, compliance, and financial reports.
  • Collaborate with university compliance offices to address regulatory requirements and audit findings.

Training and Development

  • Conduct training sessions for PIs, departmental staff, and other stakeholders on research administration policies and systems.
  • Participate in university‑wide discussions on process improvement and best practices in research administration.

Collaboration and Oversight

  • Work with the Associate Dean for Research to align daily operations with college priorities.
  • Maintain active collaboration with the Office of Research to ensure consistent training, compliance, and professional development across colleges.
  • Act as a resource for faculty and staff in navigating research administration challenges.

Core Competencies

  • Experience in effective multi‑tasking in a fast‑paced, deadline‑driven environment with a high degree of accuracy and organization, strong organizational and time management skills with exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to thrive in a busy, high‑volume, and deadline‑driven work team environment that requires coordination of multiple activities and the judgment and flexibility to reprioritize to accommodate emergency request.
  • Must be able to speak confidently when communicating with investigators and internal and external research stakeholders, excellent customer service skills, and outstanding written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills. Incumbents must be able to write and interpret technical contract language, understand its implications, and effectively communicate with and serve as liaisons between granting agencies, University administration, and the principal investigators.

Minimum Requirements

  • BA, BBA, or BS (foreign equivalent or higher) in Business, Finance, Accounting, or other related fields and 5 years of professional experience in research administration.
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
  • Advanced knowledge of federal, state, and local regulations governing sponsored research, including Uniform Guidance and FAR clauses.
  • Excellent communication skills, including conveying complex concepts to non‑specialist audiences.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a cross‑functional, fast‑paced environment.
  • Proficiency in research administration systems (e.g., Cayuse, Workday).
